703.rest: — "For thus the verse says: 'You shall afflict yourselves on the ninth' — the eating of the ninth I call affliction. And since his eating is reckoned as affliction, whoever increases eating and drinking, the more the better; for since it says 'in the evening,' it is clearly not concerned with an affliction on the ninth, and when it calls the ninth 'affliction,' it means his eating and drinking."

704.label: Yoma 81b
704.rest: — "Chiya bar Rav of Difti taught: 'And you shall afflict your souls on the ninth' (Vayikra 23:32) — do they fast on the ninth? Do they not fast on the tenth? Rather, to tell you: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth, Scripture regards him as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth." Rashi: prepare yourself on the ninth so that you will be able to fast on the tenth.

705.label: Chullin 83a (Mishnah)
705.rest: — "At four times in the year, one who sells an animal to his fellow must inform him: I sold its mother to be slaughtered…: the eve of the last Yom Tov of the festival, the eve of the first Yom Tov of Pesach, the eve of Atzeres and the eve of Rosh Hashanah; and according to Rabbi Yosi HaGelili, also the eve of Yom Kippur in the Galil."

706.label: Tosafos, Kesubos 5a (s.v. ella)
706.rest: — On Erev Yom Kippur they were accustomed to serve much fowl and fish, as is implied in Bereishis Rabbah (11) regarding the tailor who bought a fish, because it is a day of forgiveness and atonement.

707.label: Shabbos 140b
707.rest: — "Rav Chisda said: I ate vegetables neither in my poverty nor in my wealth: in my poverty, because they whet the appetite; in my wealth, because I said: where vegetables would enter, let meat and fish enter."

708.label: Bava Kamma 71b–72a
708.rest: — The next morning Rav Nachman said to Rava: "'Five oxen,' said the Torah — even five halves of oxen. And the reason I did not tell you last night is that I had not eaten ox meat."

709.label: Tosafos, Rosh Hashanah 9b (s.v. ke'ilu)
709.rest: — According to Rabbi Yishmael there is no such exposition; "and with this it is well that it does not say there, 'All agree regarding Erev Yom Kippur that we also require "for you,"' as it says there regarding Atzeres."

710.label: Zohar III 68b (Acharei Mos)
710.rest: — "'You shall afflict your souls (nafshoseichem)' (Vayikra 16:29) — 'your souls' it says, for Israel are found meritorious before the holy King and their will is toward the Holy One, to cleave to Him so that their sins be atoned. Therefore whoever eats and drinks on the ninth and delights his soul with food and drink is found on the tenth with affliction of the soul in two portions, and it is as though he fasted the ninth and the tenth."

711.label: Shelah, Maseches Yoma (Torah Or)
711.rest: — "'Whoever eats and drinks on the ninth, Scripture credits him as though he fasted the ninth and the tenth' (Berachos 8b): for the eating of the ninth is for the sake of the fast of the tenth, and so the eating is included in the fasting."

712.label: Taanis 11a
712.rest: — "Shmuel said: Whoever sits in a fast is called a sinner. He holds like this Tanna, as it was taught: Rabbi Elazar HaKappar Beribi says: What does the verse teach, 'And he shall atone for him for having sinned against the soul' (Bamidbar 6:11)? Against which soul did this one sin? Rather, that he afflicted himself by abstaining from wine."

713.label: Avodah Zarah 11a (so too Berachos 57b)
713.rest: — "'Two nations (goyim) are in your womb' (Bereishis 25:23): Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: Do not read goyim but ge'im (proud ones) — this is Antoninus and Rebbi, from whose tables neither lettuce nor cucumber nor radish ever ceased, neither in summer nor in winter."

714.label: Kesubos 104a
714.rest: — "At the time of Rebbi's passing he raised his ten fingers upward and said: Master of the world, it is revealed and known before You that I toiled with my ten fingers in Torah and did not benefit even with my little finger; may it be Your will that there be peace in my repose. A heavenly voice went forth: 'He shall come in peace; they shall rest on their beds' (Yeshayahu 57:2)."

715.label: Berachos 61a
715.rest: — "Rav said: The evil inclination resembles a fly and sits between the two openings of the heart, as it says, 'Dead flies make the perfumer's oil putrid' (Koheles 10:1). Shmuel said: It resembles a kind of wheat (chitah), as it says, 'Sin (chatas) crouches at the door' (Bereishis 4:7)."

716.label: Zohar III 68b (Acharei Mos)
716.rest: — "'You shall afflict your souls (nafshoseichem)' (Vayikra 16:29) — 'your souls' it says, for Israel are found meritorious before the holy King and their will is toward the Holy One, to cleave to Him so that their sins be atoned. Therefore whoever eats and drinks on the ninth and delights his soul with food and drink is found on the tenth with affliction of the soul in two portions, and it is as though he fasted the ninth and the tenth."

717.label: Bava Kamma 41b
717.rest: — "They derive it from 'es besaro' (Shemos 21:28) — what is secondary to his flesh. What is that? His skin."

718.label: Sanhedrin 91b
718.rest: — "A parable of a king of flesh and blood who had a beautiful orchard with fine early figs, and he set in it two guards, one lame and one blind. The lame one said to the blind one: I see fine early figs in the orchard; come, carry me, and we will bring them to eat. The lame one rode upon the blind one; they brought them and ate them." The king then set the lame upon the blind and judged them together — so the Holy One judges body and soul together.

719.label: Berachos 17a
719.rest: — "When Rav Sheshes sat in a fast, after praying he would say: Master of the worlds, it is revealed before You that when the Beis HaMikdash stood, a person who sinned brought an offering, and only its fat and blood were offered, and he was atoned. Now I have sat in a fast and my fat and blood have diminished; may it be Your will that my diminished fat and blood be as though I had offered them before You on the altar."

720.label: Tosafos, Rosh Hashanah 9b (s.v. ke'ilu)
720.rest: — According to Rabbi Yishmael there is no such exposition; "and with this it is well that it does not say there, 'All agree regarding Erev Yom Kippur that we also require "for you,"' as it says there regarding Atzeres."

721.label: Pesachim 68b
721.rest: — "Mar the son of Ravina would sit in fasting the whole year except on Atzeres, Purim and Erev Yom Kippur: Atzeres — the day the Torah was given; Purim — 'days of feasting and joy' is written; Erev Yom Kippur — as Chiya bar Rav of Difti taught: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth is regarded as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth."

722.label: Chullin 83a (Mishnah)
722.rest: — "At four times in the year, one who sells an animal to his fellow must inform him: I sold its mother to be slaughtered…: the eve of the last Yom Tov of the festival, the eve of the first Yom Tov of Pesach, the eve of Atzeres and the eve of Rosh Hashanah; and according to Rabbi Yosi HaGelili, also the eve of Yom Kippur in the Galil."

723.label: Rashi, Rosh Hashanah 9a (s.v. kol ha'ochel)
723.rest: — "For thus the verse says: 'You shall afflict yourselves on the ninth' — the eating of the ninth I call affliction. And since his eating is reckoned as affliction, whoever increases eating and drinking, the more the better; for since it says 'in the evening,' it is clearly not concerned with an affliction on the ninth, and when it calls the ninth 'affliction,' it means his eating and drinking."

724.label: Rosh, Yoma 8:22
724.rest: — It is a mitzvah to eat and drink much on Erev Yom Kippur; and he brings from the Midrash the story of the Jewish tailor who bought a fish for twelve dinars on Erev Yom Kippur, and was rewarded for honoring the day.

725.label: Bava Basra 17a
725.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: Four died through the counsel (eitiyo) of the serpent: Binyamin son of Yaakov, Amram the father of Moshe, Yishai the father of David, and Kilav son of David." Rashi: they were not fit to die, but the decree of death fell on all the descendants of Adam through the counsel of the serpent.

726.label: Tur, Orach Chaim 604
726.rest: — It is a mitzvah to eat and to make the meal plentiful on Erev Yom Kippur; and the Midrash tells of the tailor who bought a fish for twelve dinars on Erev Yom Kippur, and was rewarded for honoring the day.

727.label: Bava Basra 74b
727.rest: — "There too, let Him castrate the male and cool the female! — Fish are licentious."

728.label: Zohar I 137a–b (Midrash HaNe'elam, Toldos)
728.rest: — At first, when [the evil inclination] was soiled with sins in this world, it was called Lot; in the future, when it will no longer be soiled as before — like one who has washed and immersed from his impurity — they call it Lavan (white). In any case, the evil inclination is not abolished from the world.

729.label: Bava Basra 16b
729.rest: — "Another explanation: that Yishmael did teshuvah in his [Avraham's] days."

730.label: Yoma 75a
730.rest: — "Just as an infant tastes many tastes in the breast, so the manna: as long as Israel ate it, they found in it many tastes."

731.label: Yoma 67b
731.rest: — "The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: Azazel — for it atones for the deed of Uza and Aza'el." Rashi: destroying angels who came down to earth in the days of Na'amah… that is, it atones for sins of immorality.

732.label: Shabbos 86b
732.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: On the sixth of the month the Ten Commandments were given to Israel… and all agree that on Shabbos the Torah was given to Israel."

733.label: Sanhedrin 86a
733.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: An anonymous Mishnah is Rabbi Meir; an anonymous Tosefta is Rabbi Nechemiah; an anonymous Sifra is Rabbi Yehudah; an anonymous Sifrei is Rabbi Shimon — and all of them follow Rabbi Akiva."

734.label: Bava Kamma 60b
734.rest: — "The Holy One said: I must pay for the fire that I kindled. I kindled a fire in Tziyon, as it says, 'And He kindled a fire in Tziyon, and it consumed its foundations' (Eichah 4:11), and I will rebuild it with fire, as it says, 'And I will be for her a wall of fire all around, and for glory I will be in her midst' (Zechariah 2:9)."

735.label: Yoma 81b
735.rest: — "Chiya bar Rav of Difti taught: 'And you shall afflict your souls on the ninth' (Vayikra 23:32) — do they fast on the ninth? Do they not fast on the tenth? Rather, to tell you: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth, Scripture regards him as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth." Rashi: prepare yourself on the ninth so that you will be able to fast on the tenth.

736.label: Pri Etz Chaim, Shaar Yom HaKippurim 1
736.rest: — The ninth corresponds to Yesod… "and now on Erev Yom Kippur we must rectify the Yesod and Malchus of the Nukva, and these are rectified only in the aspect of the external, through our outward eating and drinking; therefore one must increase in eating and drinking on this day."

737.label: Midrash Tehillim 114:4
737.rest: — "'The sea saw and fled' (Tehillim 114:3): the sea saw Israel contending with one another to sanctify His Name… Another explanation: it saw the coffin of Yosef descending into the sea. The Holy One, blessed be He, said: Let it flee before the one who fled, as it is written, 'and he fled and went outside' (Bereishis 39:12)."

738.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
738.rest: — "As Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'The utterance of David son of Yishai, and the utterance of the man raised on high (hukam al)' (II Shmuel 23:1)? The utterance of David son of Yishai, who raised up the yoke (ullah) of teshuvah."

739.label: Midrash Tehillim 76
739.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah bar Ilai said: When Israel stood at the sea, they stood disputing with one another — this one said, I will go down first, and that one said, I will go down first. Meanwhile Nachshon ben Aminadav leaped into the waves of the sea, and of him it says, 'Save me, God, for the waters have come up to the soul' (Tehillim 69:2)."

740.label: Sotah 36b
740.rest: — "Rav Chana bar Bizna said in the name of Rabbi Shimon Chasida: Yosef, who sanctified the Name of Heaven in private, had one letter of the Name of the Holy One added to him [Yehosef]; Yehudah, who sanctified the Name of Heaven in public, was called entirely by the Name of the Holy One."

741.label: Zohar III 68b (Acharei Mos)
741.rest: — "'You shall afflict your souls (nafshoseichem)' (Vayikra 16:29) — 'your souls' it says, for Israel are found meritorious before the holy King and their will is toward the Holy One, to cleave to Him so that their sins be atoned. Therefore whoever eats and drinks on the ninth and delights his soul with food and drink is found on the tenth with affliction of the soul in two portions, and it is as though he fasted the ninth and the tenth."

742.label: Chullin 83a (Mishnah)
742.rest: — "At four times in the year, one who sells an animal to his fellow must inform him: I sold its mother to be slaughtered…: the eve of the last Yom Tov of the festival, the eve of the first Yom Tov of Pesach, the eve of Atzeres and the eve of Rosh Hashanah; and according to Rabbi Yosi HaGelili, also the eve of Yom Kippur in the Galil."

743.label: Zohar I 26a (Bereishis)
743.rest: — "At that time it will be said of Moshe and Israel, 'Then you shall delight (tisaneg) upon Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14) — with oneg, which is ayin, Eden; nun, nahar (river); gimel, gan (garden)… and it will be turned for the Erev Rav, from oneg (delight) to nega (plague)."

744.label: Zohar III, 65b (Achrei Mot)
744.rest: — “Come and see: Yud at the beginning includes all, concealed on every side; the paths have not opened. It includes male and female. The upper tip of yud alludes to Ayin. Afterward comes yud, which brings forth the river that flows and goes out from it, so that heh may become pregnant from it. Concerning this it is written, ‘A river goes out from Eden’—‘goes out,’ rather than ‘went out.’”

745.label: Shabbos 118a
745.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said in the name of Rabbi Yosi: Whoever delights the Shabbos is given an inheritance without boundaries, as it says, 'Then you shall delight in Hashem, and I will make you ride upon the heights of the earth, and I will feed you the inheritance of Yaakov your father' (Yeshayahu 58:14)." Rashi: without boundaries — that has no end.

746.label: Zohar II 88b (Yisro)
746.rest: — Because all faith is found in Shabbos, a person is given another soul, a supernal soul in which all completeness is found, in the likeness of the World to Come; and therefore it is called Shabbos.

747.label: Zohar II 204b (Vayakhel)
747.rest: — If he cancels the delight of Shabbos and takes delight on a weekday, it is as though he esteemed something else more than the Holy One; the supernal holy spirit that rests upon him [on Shabbos] he did not delight, and he cancelled it from himself.

748.label: Tur and Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chaim 288:3
748.rest: — Some say that one for whom fasting is a delight, since eating would distress him, may fast on Shabbos.

749.label: Chullin 89a
749.rest: — "'Not because you are more numerous than all the peoples did Hashem desire you' (Devarim 7:7): The Holy One, blessed be He, said to Israel: I desire you, for even when I bestow greatness upon you, you diminish yourselves before Me."

750.label: Zohar (Tetzaveh)
750.rest: — "'For on this day He shall atone for you, to purify you' (Vayikra 16:30) — it should have said 'this day'; what is 'on this day'? Because the Sanctuary above is purified, cleansed and illuminated…"

751.label: Nedarim 8b
751.rest: — "There is no Gehinnom in the World to Come; rather, the Holy One, blessed be He, takes the sun out of its sheath: the righteous are healed by it and the wicked are judged by it, as it says, 'And for you who fear My Name a sun of righteousness shall shine, with healing in its wings' (Malachi 3:20)."

752.label: Taanis 31a
752.rest: — "In the future the Holy One will make a dance for the righteous, and He will sit among them in Gan Eden, and each one will point with his finger, as it says, 'And it shall be said on that day: Behold, this is our God, for whom we hoped, that He would save us' (Yeshayahu 25:9)."

753.label: Shabbos 89b
753.rest: — “If your sins are like these years, which are arranged and come from the six days of creation until now, they will be made white as snow.”

754.label: Zohar II 184a, Tetzaveh
754.rest: — “There is no good except that which emerges from within evil.”

755.label: Yerushalmi, Yoma 5:2
755.rest: — "Every year that I entered the Holy of Holies, an old man dressed in white and wrapped in white would enter with me and leave with me… They asked before Rabbi Abahu: But it is written, 'And no man shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he comes to atone in the Sanctuary, until he goes out' (Vayikra 16:17) — even those of whom it is written, 'and the likeness of their faces was the face of a man' (Yechezkel 1:10), shall not be in the Tent of Meeting!"

756.label: Zohar III 201b (Balak)
756.rest: — "Three mouths were created on the eve of Shabbos at twilight. When the day became sanctified, there ascended the mouth that rules over all the other mouths — and which is it? That day which ascended and was sanctified in all, which is called 'the mouth of Hashem.'"

757.label: Sefer Yetzirah 4
757.rest: — "He made the letter tav king… and formed with it… the day of Shabbos in the year, and the mouth in the soul."

758.label: Zohar I 47b (Bereishis)
758.rest: — “‘And God finished on the seventh day’: this is Torah she'b'al peh, which is the seventh day.”

759.label: Yoma 52b (Mishnah)
759.rest: — "He reached the Ark, placed the firepan between the two poles, heaped the incense upon the coals, and the whole house filled with smoke. He went out by the way he had entered, and prayed a short prayer in the outer chamber; and he did not prolong his prayer, so as not to frighten Israel."

760.label: Mishnah, Yoma 1:3
760.rest: — "The elders of the court said to him: My master, Kohen Gadol (ishi kohen gadol), read with your own mouth, perhaps you have forgotten or perhaps you never learned."

761.label: Yoma 71a
761.rest: — "'To you, ishim (men), I call' (Mishlei 8:4) — Rabbi Berechyah said: these are Torah scholars, who are like women (weak in body), yet do mighty deeds like men."

762.label: R. Yisrael of Kozhnitz, Avodas Yisrael, Yom Kippur
762.rest: — On Yoma 71b (“Let the descendants of the nations come in peace, who do the deed of Aharon”): “Our master the Maggid explained of Rabbi Yishmael ben Elisha, who entered to offer the incense and saw Achtariel, that although he was great among the sages, he merited that wondrous vision not by his own merit alone but through the Tanna of his generation, who raised him in his holiness. Accordingly, the Kohen in the days of Shemaya and Avtalyon, in the Second Temple, who was not so worthy, merited to enter the Holy of Holies on Yom Kippur only through Shemaya and Avtalyon, the heads of the generation, who raised him to that level. Therefore they answered the Kohen Gadol that he should not be haughty toward them, for they ‘did the deed of Aharon’ — the essence of the service was through them.”

763.label: Zohar III 214b (Pinchas)
763.rest: — "Like this order of these days from Rosh Hashanah until the last day of the festival: on Rosh Hashanah the left arm is aroused to receive the Matronita, and then the whole world is in fear and in judgment, and that time requires complete teshuvah… Afterward the Matronita comes, and the members of the palace must, on the ninth of the month, make joy and immerse in the river to purify themselves for the union of the Matronita."

764.label: Shabbos 31a
764.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: What is meant by 'And He shall be the faith of your times, a strength of salvations, wisdom and knowledge' (Yeshayahu 33:6)? 'Faith' — this is the order of Zera'im; 'your times' — the order of Mo'ed; 'strength' — the order of Nashim; 'salvations' — the order of Nezikin; 'wisdom' — the order of Kodashim; 'and knowledge' — the order of Taharos."

765.label: Zohar I 129a (Chayei Sarah)
765.rest: — "When he grew old and entered the supernal grades — 'And Avraham was old,' and then 'came into days,' into those supernal days… Fortunate are the masters of teshuvah, for in one hour, one day, one moment they draw near to the Holy One, which was not so even for complete tzaddikim, who drew near over many years… The baal teshuvah at once enters and cleaves to the Holy One."

766.label: Yoma 81b
766.rest: — "Chiya bar Rav of Difti taught: 'And you shall afflict your souls on the ninth' (Vayikra 23:32) — do they fast on the ninth? Do they not fast on the tenth? Rather, to tell you: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth, Scripture regards him as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth." Rashi: prepare yourself on the ninth so that you will be able to fast on the tenth.

767.label: Rashi, Rosh Hashanah 9a (s.v. kol ha'ochel)
767.rest: — "For thus the verse says: 'You shall afflict yourselves on the ninth' — the eating of the ninth I call affliction. And since his eating is reckoned as affliction, whoever increases eating and drinking, the more the better; for since it says 'in the evening,' it is clearly not concerned with an affliction on the ninth, and when it calls the ninth 'affliction,' it means his eating and drinking."

768.label: Rosh, Yoma 8:22
768.rest: — It is a mitzvah to eat and drink much on Erev Yom Kippur; and he brings from the Midrash the story of the Jewish tailor who bought a fish for twelve dinars on Erev Yom Kippur, and was rewarded for honoring the day.

769.label: Chullin 83a (Mishnah)
769.rest: — "At these four times they compel the butcher to slaughter against his will, even an ox worth a thousand dinar, when the buyer has [paid] only a dinar."

770.label: Pesikta Rabbasi 46:1
770.rest: — On that day too the daylight was extended thirty-six hours, for the measure of night did not apply; when Adam sinned he was banished that very day, and the next day was Rosh Hashanah [and Shabbos protected him].

771.label: Avodah Zarah 8a
771.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: On the day Adam HaRishon was created, when the sun set upon him he said: Woe is me, for because I sinned the world is darkening around me and will return to tohu va'vohu — and this is the death decreed upon me from Heaven. He sat fasting and weeping all night, and Chavah wept opposite him. When dawn rose, he said: It is the way of the world. He rose and offered an ox whose horns preceded its hooves, as it says, 'And it shall please Hashem better than an ox, a bull with horns and hooves' (Tehillim 69:32)."

772.label: Berachos 4a
772.rest: — Though Yaakov had been promised, "Behold, I am with you" (Bereishis 28:15), he was afraid (Bereishis 32:8), for he said: perhaps sin will cause it.

773.label: Rambam, Hilchos Mikvaos 11:12
773.rest: — "Nevertheless there is a hint in the matter: just as one who directs his heart to purify himself, once he has immersed, is pure, even though nothing new has occurred in his body, so one who directs his heart to purify his soul from the impurities of souls — thoughts of iniquity and evil beliefs — once he resolves in his heart to separate from those counsels and brings his soul into the waters of knowledge, he is pure."

774.label: Tosafos, Rosh Hashanah 9b (s.v. ke'ilu)
774.rest: — According to Rabbi Yishmael there is no such exposition; "and with this it is well that it does not say there, 'All agree regarding Erev Yom Kippur that we also require "for you,"' as it says there regarding Atzeres."

775.label: Pesachim 68b
775.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: All agree regarding Atzeres that we also require 'for you.' What is the reason? It is the day on which the Torah was given. Rabbah said: All agree regarding Shabbos… Rav Yosef said: All agree regarding Purim." Rashi: one should rejoice with food and drink, to show that this day on which the Torah was given is pleasing and welcome to Israel.

776.label: Rashi, Rosh Hashanah 9a (s.v. kol ha'ochel)
776.rest: — "For thus the verse says: 'You shall afflict yourselves on the ninth' — the eating of the ninth I call affliction. And since his eating is reckoned as affliction, whoever increases eating and drinking, the more the better; for since it says 'in the evening,' it is clearly not concerned with an affliction on the ninth, and when it calls the ninth 'affliction,' it means his eating and drinking."

777.label: Taanis 15a
777.rest: — “The righteous are for light, and the upright for gladness, as it is written: ‘and for the upright in heart, gladness’ (Tehillim 97:11).”

778.label: Sukkah 52a
778.rest: — "Granted according to the one who says [the mourning] is over Mashiach ben Yosef who is killed — that is why it is written, 'And they shall look to Me whom they pierced, and they shall mourn over him as one mourns for an only son' (Zechariah 12:10). But according to the one who says it is over the evil inclination that is killed — one should rejoice; why weep?"

779.label: Zohar II 14b–15a (Shemos)
779.rest: — "He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah, Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah, and Yaakov in the secret of Da'as."

780.label: Yoma 28b
780.rest: — "Rav Chama bar Chanina said: From the days of our forefathers yeshivah never departed from them… Avraham Avinu was an elder sitting in yeshivah, as it says, 'And Avraham was old (zaken)' (Bereishis 24:1); Yitzchak Avinu was an elder sitting in yeshivah, as it says, 'And it was when Yitzchak was old' (27:1); Yaakov Avinu was an elder sitting in yeshivah, as it says, 'And the eyes of Israel were heavy with age' (48:10)."

781.label: Zohar II 175b (Terumah)
781.rest: — "Chochmah is the sum of all; supernal Chesed issues from Chochmah; Gevurah, which is severe judgment, issues from Binah; Yaakov completes both sides, and the Avos include all, and Yaakov includes the Avos."

782.label: Zohar III 65b (Acharei Mos)
782.rest: — "The Yud at first is the totality of all, hidden on every side... The upper tip of the Yud alludes to Ayin (Nothingness)." Zohar III 10b (Vayikra): "The Yud of the holy Name is tied with three knots: one tip above, one below and one in the middle. The tip above is Kesser Elyon, highest of all the highest, head of all heads."

783.label: Yoma 70a (Mishnah)
783.rest: — "They brought him his own garments and he dressed, and they escorted him to his home; and he would make a festive day for his loved ones when he came out in peace from the Sanctuary."

784.label: Yoma 53b
784.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: It happened that a certain Kohen Gadol prolonged his prayer, and his brethren the Kohanim resolved to enter after him. As they began to enter, he came out. They said to him: Why did you prolong your prayer? He said to them: Is it hard in your eyes that I prayed for you and for the Beis HaMikdash, that it not be destroyed? They said to him: Do not make a habit of it, for we learned: he would not prolong his prayer, so as not to frighten Israel."

785.label: Yoma 71b
785.rest: — "At last Shemayah and Avtalyon came to take leave of the Kohen Gadol. He said to them: Let the descendants of the nations come in peace. They said to him: Let the descendants of the nations come in peace, who do the deed of Aharon; and let not the descendant of Aharon come in peace, who does not do the deed of Aharon." Rashi: the deed of Aharon — pursuing peace.

786.label: Avos 1:12
786.rest: — "Hillel says: Be of the disciples of Aharon — loving peace and pursuing peace, loving the creatures and bringing them close to Torah."

787.label: Zohar III 242b (Pinchas)
787.rest: — "The body and the covenant are counted as one."

788.label: Mechilta, Yisro, Bachodesh 1
788.rest: — "'And Israel encamped there' (Shemos 19:2): wherever it says 'they journeyed… they encamped,' they journeyed in dispute and encamped in dispute; but here they were all of one heart."

789.label: Berachos 64a
789.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said in the name of Rabbi Chanina: Torah scholars increase peace in the world, as it says, 'And all your children shall be taught of Hashem, and great shall be the peace of your children' (Yeshayahu 54:13) — do not read banayich (your children) but bonayich (your builders)."

790.label: Bereishis Rabbah 49:2
790.rest: — "There is not a day on which the Holy One does not innovate a halachah in the Heavenly Court."

791.label: Rashi, Shemos 31:3
791.rest: — "'With wisdom' — what a person hears from others and learns; 'and with understanding' — that he understands a matter from his own heart, from what he has learned; 'and with knowledge' — ruach hakodesh."

792.label: Mishnah, Mikvaos 9:6
792.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi says: [stains] of builders (bana'im) — on one side [interposes]." Cf. Shabbos 114a: "Who are bana'im? These are Torah scholars, who are engaged in the building of the world all their days."

793.label: Yoma 19b
793.rest: — "Eliyahu said to Rav Yehudah, the brother of Rav Sala Chasida: You say, Why does Mashiach not come? But today is Yom Kippur, and how many maidens were violated in Neharde'a!"

794.label: Yoma 9b
794.rest: — “The second Temple: they occupied themselves with Torah, commandments, and acts of kindness. Why was it destroyed? Because it contained baseless hatred. This teaches that baseless hatred is equivalent to the three transgressions of idolatry, forbidden relations, and bloodshed. ... Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Elazar both said: The earlier ones, whose sin was revealed, had the end of their exile revealed; the later ones, whose sin was not revealed, did not have their end revealed.” The Gemara contrasts visible religious achievement with destructive hatred and the differing revelation of the exile's end. Rav Tzadok links this inward failure with the concealed opposition of Edom.

795.label: Yoma 9b
795.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Elazar both said: The earlier ones, whose sin was revealed, their end was revealed; the later ones, whose sin was not revealed, their end was not revealed." The Second Temple, though they occupied themselves there with Torah, mitzvos and acts of kindness, was destroyed because of baseless hatred.

796.label: Kerisos 6b
796.rest: — "Any fast in which the sinners of Israel do not take part is not a fast, for chelbenah has a foul odor, yet Scripture counted it among the spices of the incense."

797.label: Chagigah 26a
797.rest: — "'And all the men of Israel gathered to the city, as one man, chaverim' (Shoftim 20:11) — Scripture made them all chaverim."

798.label: Berachos 6a
798.rest: — "What is 'and for those who think of His Name' (Malachi 3:16)? Rav Ashi said: If a person thought to do a mitzvah and was prevented and did not do it, Scripture regards him as though he did it."

799.label: Sotah 33a
799.rest: — "Yochanan the Kohen Gadol heard a heavenly voice from the Holy of Holies saying: The young men who went to wage war at Antioch have triumphed. And again it happened with Shimon HaTzaddik, who heard a heavenly voice from the Holy of Holies saying: The work that the enemy said to bring against the Sanctuary has been annulled; and Gaskalgas was killed and his decrees annulled… A heavenly voice is different, for it is made to be heard."

800.label: Zohar II 121a (Mishpatim)
800.rest: — "The Torah emerged from Chochmah, from the place called Kodesh (holy); and Chochmah emerged from the place called Kodesh HaKodashim (Holy of Holies)."

801.label: Berachos 7a
801.rest: — "R. Yishmael ben Elisha said: Once I entered the innermost sanctum to offer incense, and I saw Achtriel Yah, Hashem of Hosts, seated on a high and exalted throne. He said to me: Yishmael My son, bless Me. I said: May it be Your will that Your mercy conquer Your anger… and that You deal with Your children with the attribute of mercy. And He nodded His head to me."

802.label: Sanhedrin 11a
802.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: Once the last prophets — Chaggai, Zechariah and Malachi — died, ruach hakodesh departed from Israel, and even so they made use of a heavenly voice. Once they were reclining in the upper chamber of the house of Guria in Yericho, and a heavenly voice was given to them from Heaven: There is one here who is fit that the Shechinah rest upon him as upon Moshe Rabbeinu, but his generation is not worthy. The Sages set their eyes on Hillel the Elder; and when he died they said of him: Alas, the pious one! Alas, the humble one! A disciple of Ezra."

803.label: Sotah 48b
803.rest: — "And again, another time, they were reclining in an upper chamber in Yavneh, and a heavenly voice was given to them from Heaven: There is among you a man who is fit that the Shechinah rest upon him, but his generation is not worthy. They set their eyes on Shmuel HaKatan."

804.label: Sotah 12a
804.rest: — “When Moshe was born, the whole house was filled with light.”

805.label: Tosafos, Sanhedrin 11a (s.v. bas kol)
805.rest: — "Some say they did not hear the voice that goes out from Heaven, but from that voice another voice goes out — as when a person strikes forcefully and hears another sound going out from it at a distance — and that voice they would hear; therefore it is called bas kol, the 'daughter' of a voice."

806.label: Zohar III 214b (Pinchas)
806.rest: — "Like this order of these days from Rosh Hashanah until the last day of the festival: on Rosh Hashanah the left arm is aroused to receive the Matronita, and then the whole world is in fear and in judgment, and that time requires complete teshuvah… Afterward the Matronita comes, and the members of the palace must, on the ninth of the month, make joy and immerse in the river to purify themselves for the union of the Matronita."

807.label: Zohar III 271b, Eikev (Raya Mehemna)
807.rest: — the wine of the Oral Torah, “Drink of the wine I have mixed.”

808.label: Tamid 28a
808.rest: — "Rebbi says: Which is the straight path a person should choose for himself? Let him love rebuke… And some say: Let him hold fast to surpassing faith (emunah yeseirah), as it says, 'My eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with Me' (Tehillim 101:6)." [No Rashi on this amud.]

809.label: Moed Katan 9a
809.rest: — "Rabbi Parnach said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: That year Israel did not keep Yom Kippur, and they were worried and said: Perhaps the enemies of Israel are liable to destruction. A heavenly voice went forth and said to them: All of you are destined for the life of the World to Come."

810.label: Zohar III 214b (Pinchas)
810.rest: — "And then Israel are in fasting for their sins, and it atones for them, for Imma Ila'ah illuminates the face of the Matronita in her union, and all the members of the palace are atoned."

811.label: Shabbos 56b
811.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: At the time David said to Mefiboshes, 'You and Tziva shall divide the field' (II Shmuel 19:30), a heavenly voice went forth and said to him: Rechavam and Yeravam shall divide the kingdom." And: "Had David not accepted lashon hara, the kingdom of the house of David would not have been divided."

812.label: Zohar III 84b (Kedoshim)
812.rest: — "Rabbi Chiya said: At first, 'I am Hashem your God,' 'Remember the Shabbos day,' 'You shall not take,' 'You shall not murder,' 'You shall not commit adultery,' 'You shall not steal' — in the singular; and here, 'I am Hashem your God (Elokeichem),' 'Every man shall fear his mother and father, and keep My Shabbosos' — in the plural? But come and see: from the day Israel were found in the world, they were never found before the Holy One with one heart and one will as on that day they stood at Mount Sinai; therefore all was said in the singular."

813.label: Mechilta, Yisro, Bachodesh 1
813.rest: — "'And Israel encamped there' (Shemos 19:2): wherever it says 'they journeyed… they encamped,' they journeyed in dispute and encamped in dispute; but here they were all of one heart."

814.label: Kiddushin 31a
814.rest: — "Rav Yosef said: At first I said: Whoever tells me that the halachah follows Rabbi Yehudah, who said a blind man is exempt from the mitzvos, I would make a festive day for the Rabbis, for I am not commanded and yet I do. Now that I have heard Rabbi Chanina's statement, 'Greater is one who is commanded and does than one who is not commanded and does,' on the contrary — whoever tells me that the halachah does not follow Rabbi Yehudah, I will make a festive day for the Rabbis."

815.label: Rashi, Kiddushin 31a (s.v. yoma tava l'Rabbanan)
815.rest: — On Rav Yosef's words, "Whoever tells me that the halachah follows Rabbi Yehudah, I will make a festive day for the Rabbis": "A festive day for the Rabbis — a feast for the students."

816.label: Shabbos 118b–119a
816.rest: — "Abaye said: May I be rewarded, for when I see a young scholar who has completed his tractate, I make a festive day for the Rabbis." Rashi: for the students, for he was head of the yeshivah.

817.label: Chullin 137a
817.rest: — "Rav Kahana said: The verse says, 'five sheep ready-dressed (asuyos)' (I Shmuel 25:18) — that make two mitzvos: the first shearing and the gifts."

818.label: Berachos 6a
818.rest: — "What is 'and for those who think of His Name' (Malachi 3:16)? Rav Ashi said: If a person thought to do a mitzvah and was prevented and did not do it, Scripture regards him as though he did it."

819.label: Arachin 16b
819.rest: — "Why is the metzora different, that the Torah said, 'He shall dwell alone; outside the camp is his dwelling' (Vayikra 13:46)? He separated between a man and his wife, between a man and his fellow; therefore the Torah said, 'He shall dwell alone.'" Rashi: for the plagues came upon him because of lashon hara.

820.label: Temurah 16a
820.rest: — "'Give me a blessing, for you have given me the land of the Negev' (Yehoshua 15:19) — a house dried out (menugav) of all good; 'and give me springs of water' — a man who has nothing but Torah alone."

821.label: Shabbos 89b
821.rest: — "They opened and said, 'For You are our Father' (Yeshayahu 63:16). Yitzchak said to them: Rather than praising me, praise the Holy One, blessed be He — and Yitzchak shows them the Holy One with their own eyes. Immediately they lifted their eyes on high."

822.label: Sanhedrin 93b
822.rest: — "Daniel, Chananyah, Mishael and Azaryah, of whom it is written, 'Youths in whom there was no blemish, of good appearance, skilled in all wisdom… and who had strength to stand in the king's palace' (Daniel 1:4)… Rabbi Chama son of Rabbi Chanina said: This teaches that they restrained themselves from laughter, from conversation and from sleep, out of awe of the kingdom."

823.label: Taanis 16a
823.rest: — "Rav Ada bar Ahavah said: A person who has a sin in his hand and confesses but does not turn back from it — to what is he likened? To a man who holds a sheretz in his hand: even if he immerses in all the waters in the world, his immersion does not avail him; once he throws it from his hand, as soon as he immerses in forty se'ah, his immersion avails him."

824.label: Rashi, Bereishis 32:5
824.rest: — "'I sojourned (garti) with Lavan' — garti has the numerical value of 613: that is, I lived with Lavan the wicked and kept the 613 mitzvos, and did not learn from his evil ways."

825.label: Yoma 28b
825.rest: — "Rav said: Avraham Avinu fulfilled the entire Torah, as it says, 'Because Avraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes and My Torahs' (Bereishis 26:5). Rav Shimi bar Chiya said to Rav: Perhaps only the seven mitzvos? — There was milah too! — Perhaps seven and milah? — If so, why 'My commandments and My Torahs'?"

826.label: Taanis 5b
826.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Yaakov Avinu did not die. He was asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed and the buriers buried? He answered: I am expounding a verse, as it says, 'And you, fear not, My servant Yaakov… for behold, I save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity' (Yirmeyahu 30:10) — it compares him to his seed: just as his seed is alive, so too he is alive." Rashi: he lives forever; they embalmed him because they thought he had died.

827.label: Taanis 5b
827.rest: — “Rabbi Yochanan said: Our father Yaakov did not die. They asked: Was it for nothing that the eulogizers eulogized, the embalmers embalmed, and the buriers buried him? He answered: I am expounding a verse: Do not fear, My servant Yaakov ... for I shall save you from afar and your offspring from the land of their captivity. It compares him to his offspring: just as his offspring are alive, so he is alive.”

828.label: Yoma 85b (Mishnah)
828.rest: — "For transgressions between man and the Omnipresent, Yom Kippur atones; for transgressions between man and his fellow, Yom Kippur does not atone until he appeases his fellow."

829.label: Nedarim 41a
829.rest: — "Abaye said: We have a tradition: there is no poor man except in knowledge. In the West they say: One who has this has everything in him; one who lacks this — what has he? One who has acquired this — what does he lack? One who has not acquired this — what has he acquired?"

830.label: Sukkah 52a
830.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: To Mashiach ben David, who is destined to be revealed speedily in our days, the Holy One says: Ask of Me something and I will give it to you… And when he sees that Mashiach ben Yosef was killed, he says before Him: Master of the world, I ask of You only life. He says to him: Before you said it, David your father already prophesied of you, as it says, 'Life he asked of You; You gave it to him' (Tehillim 21:5)."

831.label: Sifrei, Devarim (Eikev)
831.rest: — "'Which I command you today' — let them be in your eyes as new each day, as if you had received them that very day from Sinai."

832.label: Berachos 57b
832.rest: — "Three things are a semblance of the World to Come: Shabbos, the sun, and marital relations."

833.label: Bava Basra 16b–17a
833.rest: — "Three were given a taste of the World to Come in this world: Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov — Avraham, of whom it is written 'with all' (bakol, Bereishis 24:1); Yitzchak, of whom it is written 'of all' (mikol, 27:33); Yaakov, of whom it is written 'all' (kol, 33:11)."

834.label: Berachos 17a
834.rest: — "When the Rabbis took leave of the house of Rabbi Ami — some say, of Rabbi Chanina — they said to him: May you see your world in your lifetime, and may your end be for the life of Olam Haba, and your hope for all generations; may your heart meditate understanding, your mouth speak wisdom, and your eyes shine with the light of Torah."

835.label: Koheles Rabbah 9:7
835.rest: — On every Yom Kippur a heavenly voice goes forth and says: "Go, eat your bread with joy and drink your wine with a glad heart, for God has already accepted your deeds" (Koheles 9:7).

836.label: Arachin 11a
836.rest: — "Rav Masna said: From here: 'Because you did not serve Hashem your God with joy and with gladness of heart' (Devarim 28:47) — which is service with joy and gladness of heart? You must say: this is song."

837.label: Tosafos, Arachin 11a (s.v. mesamchei lev)
837.rest: — On the Gemara's statement that words of Torah are called "gladdening the heart" (Tehillim 19:9) but not "good [heart]": "And if you ask: but it is written, 'And his heart was good' (Rus 3:7), and Rashi explains there from the Midrash that 'his heart was good' means he engaged in Torah study!" — and see there what they answer.

838.label: Berachos 54a
838.rest: — "A person must bless over the bad just as he blesses over the good, as it says, 'And you shall love Hashem your God with all your heart (levavecha)…' — with both your inclinations, the good inclination and the evil inclination; 'and with all your soul' — even if He takes your soul; 'and with all your might' — with all your money."

839.label: Sukkah 52b
839.rest: — “If this repulsive one encounters you, drag him to the beis midrash.”

840.label: Sukkah 52b
840.rest: — “A person’s inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him … and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says: Hashem will not abandon him into his hand.”

841.label: Zohar III 271b (Ra'aya Meheimna, Eikev)
841.rest: — "Meanwhile an elder came to him and said: Faithful Shepherd, prepare a table for your Master and the Matronita with all kinds of delicacies… 'Come, eat of my bread' (Mishlei 9:5) — this is the bread of the Written Torah, and the wine of the Oral Torah; and there are many dishes, the reasons of the Torah, sweeter than all the foods and delicacies of the world."

842.label: Sukkah 52b
842.rest: — "The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: If this repulsive one meets you, drag him to the study hall: if he is stone, he will dissolve; if he is iron, he will shatter… as it is written, 'Is not My word like fire, says Hashem, and like a hammer that shatters rock?' (Yirmeyahu 23:29)." Rashi: this repulsive one — the evil inclination.

843.label: Yoma 56b–57a
843.rest: — "That heretic said to Rabbi Chanina: Now you are certainly impure, as it is written, 'Her impurity is in her skirts' (Eichah 1:9). He said to him: Come and see what is written of them: 'Who dwells with them amid their impurity' (Vayikra 16:16) — even when they are impure, the Shechinah rests among them."

844.label: Kiddushin 30b
844.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon ben Levi said: A person's inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him, as it says, 'The wicked watches the righteous and seeks to kill him' (Tehillim 37:32); and were it not that the Holy One helps him, he could not withstand it, as it says, 'Hashem will not leave him in his hand' (37:33)."

845.label: Zohar III 103a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Emor)
845.rest: — "'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' (Vayikra 23:42): this commandment is to dwell in the sukkah… to show that Israel dwell in the secret of faith without any fear, for the accuser has departed from them. And whoever is in the secret of faith sits in the sukkah, as it is written, 'Every native in Israel shall dwell in sukkos' — whoever is of the secret of faith, of the seed and root of Israel, shall dwell in sukkos."

846.label: Pesikta DeRav Kahana 26
846.rest: — The prayer of the Kohen Gadol: "May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that this year be rainy, hot and dewy; a year of cheapness, a year of plenty, a year of favor, a year of blessing…" — expounding "From there he searches out food" (Iyov 39:29).

847.label: Pesikta Rabbasi 47
847.rest: — "'From there he searches out food (chafar ochel)' (Iyov 39:29) — from there he would scout out for himself the food of the year, whether it would be good or bad… and chafar is a term of scouting, as in 'and let them search out (vayachperu) the land for us' (Devarim 1:22)."

848.label: Midrash Tehillim 27
848.rest: — "The Rabbis interpret the verses as Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur: 'my light' — on Rosh Hashanah; 'and my salvation' — on Yom Kippur… The Satan in gematria is 364: all the days of the year he has permission to accuse, except on Yom Kippur… 'In this (be-zos) I trust' — Rabbi Levi said: … 'With this (be-zos) shall Aharon come into the Sanctuary' (Vayikra 16:3)."

849.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 36 (77b)
849.rest: — "'Let there be light' — this is Pesach, the night [or] of the fourteenth; 'and there was light' — Rosh Hashanah, of which it is said 'and it was [vayehi] the day'; here vayehi and there vayehi, and everywhere vayehi is a term of distress." Or l'arba'ah asar is the Mishnah's term for the night of the fourteenth (Pesachim 2a).

850.label: Zohar III 99b (Emor)
850.rest: — "'At the covered time for our festival day' (Tehillim 81:4) — when the moon is covered… And with what does all shine? With teshuvah and with the sound of the shofar, as it is written, 'Fortunate is the people that knows the teruah; Hashem, in the light of Your countenance they shall walk' (Tehillim 89:16)."

851.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 99b–100a (Emor)
851.rest: — "'And Yitzchak trembled exceedingly' (Bereishis 27:33)… 'who is he that hunted game' — through many prayers and supplications…" And Yaakov goes through the days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur fleeing to be saved from him, returning in teshuvah and fasting; for Israel know that Esav comes with four hundred men, all of them accusers ready to accuse them.

853.label: Sanhedrin 59a
853.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: An idolater who occupies himself with Torah is liable to death, as it says, 'Moshe commanded us the Torah, an inheritance (morashah) of the congregation of Yaakov' (Devarim 33:4) — an inheritance for us and not for them." The Gemara also reads it me'orasah, "betrothed."

854.label: Nedarim 31b (Mishnah)
854.rest: — "[If one vowed,] 'Konam, that I will not benefit from the uncircumcised (arelim)' — he is permitted with uncircumcised Jews and forbidden with circumcised gentiles."

855.label: Sanhedrin 58b
855.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: An idolater who keeps Shabbos is liable to death, as it says, 'Day and night they shall not cease' (Bereishis 8:22)."

856.label: Zohar I 142a (Toldos)
856.rest: — "'And now, my son, listen to my voice' (Bereishis 27:8) — that time was Erev Pesach, when the evil inclination had to be eliminated and the moon, the secret of faith, had to rule; therefore she made two dishes."

857.label: Pesachim 87b
857.rest: — “Rabbi Elazar said: The Holy One, blessed be He, exiled Israel among the nations only so that converts might be added to them, as it says, ‘I shall sow her for Myself in the land.’ Does a person sow a se’ah except to bring in many kor?” The Gemara expressly speaks of converts and compares exile with sowing. The extension to holy sparks within the nations belongs to the mystical explanation cited by Rav Tzadok.

858.label: Zohar III 100b (Emor)
858.rest: — "Then Esav, Yaakov's guardian, turned back… 'So Esav returned that day on his way to Seir' (Bereishis 33:16) — when? At the time of Ne'ilah, for he departed from the holy people, and the Holy One forgave their sins and atoned for them. Once that accuser went off with that gift and departed from them, the Holy One wished to rejoice with His children. What is written? 'And Yaakov journeyed to Sukkos' (33:17)… once they sit in sukkos, they are saved from the accuser."

859.label: Beitzah 16a
859.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: The Holy One gives a person an additional soul on Erev Shabbos, and at the departure of Shabbos they take it from him, as it says, 'He rested and was refreshed (vayinafash)' (Shemos 31:17) — once he has rested: woe, the soul is lost (vay avdah nefesh)."

860.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
860.rest: — "As Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'The utterance of David son of Yishai, and the utterance of the man raised on high (hukam al)' (II Shmuel 23:1)? The utterance of David son of Yishai, who raised up the yoke (ullah) of teshuvah."

861.label: Shabbos 63b
861.rest: — "'Rejoice, young man, in your youth… and walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these God will bring you into judgment' (Koheles 11:9)" — Reish Lakish said: Until here [refers] to words of Torah; from here on, to good deeds. (Rav Huna: until here are the words of the evil inclination; from here on, the words of the good inclination.)

862.label: Zohar II 62a (Beshalach)
862.rest: — "At first, when Israel left Egypt, they entered with the bread called matzah; now they merited to eat another, higher bread, from a higher place: 'Behold, I will rain bread for you from heaven' — from heaven itself. And the companions who toil in Torah are nourished from a place higher still, as it is written, 'Wisdom gives life to those who possess it' (Koheles 7:12)."

863.label: Zohar II 184a, Tetzaveh
863.rest: — “There is no good except that which emerges from within evil.”

864.label: Chullin 91a
864.rest: — “Rav Shmuel bar Acha said before Rav Pappa in Rava bar Ulla's name: He appeared to him as a Torah scholar, for the Master said: One who walks at his teacher's right is an uncultivated person.” The discussion asks how Yaakov's assailant stood relative to him. One view says he appeared as a gentile; this view says he appeared as a Torah scholar. Rav Tzadok applies that disguise to evil counsel that presents itself as religious instruction.

865.label: Zohar III 255b (Ra'aya Meheimna, Pinchas)
865.rest: — "'And a sukkah shall be for a shade by day' (Yeshayahu 4:6) — we require schach, and the schach is made for shade, of which it is said, 'In the shade of Shakkai he shall lodge' (Tehillim 91:1); and not in the shade of an ordinary sukkah that shields the body from the sun, but a shade to shield the soul."

866.label: Sukkah 52b
866.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said: A person's inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him, as it says, 'The wicked one watches the righteous and seeks to kill him' (Tehillim 37:32); and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says, 'Hashem will not abandon him into his hand' (Tehillim 37:33)."

867.label: Taanis 15a
867.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: I too say: not all are for light and not all are for gladness. The righteous are for light, and the upright for gladness: the righteous for light, as it is written, 'Light is sown for the righteous' (Tehillim 97:11); and the upright for gladness, as it is written, 'and for the upright of heart, gladness.'"

868.label: Zohar II 14b–15a (Shemos)
868.rest: — "The world was created with three: with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge (Shemos 31:3)... When He wished to establish the world, He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah, Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah, and Yaakov in the secret of Da'as; thus it is called 'and with da'as the chambers are filled' (Mishlei 24:4)."

869.label: Zohar III 104a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Emor)
869.rest: — "This commandment is to take the lulav on that day with its species… just as the Holy One takes Israel in these days and rejoices in them, so Israel take the Holy One as their portion and rejoice in Him."

870.label: Shabbos 31b
870.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said: The Holy One, blessed be He, created His world only so that they should fear Him, as it says, 'And God has made it so, that they should fear before Him' (Koheles 3:14)."

871.label: Avos 6:11
871.rest: — "Everything the Holy One created in His world, He created only for His glory, as it says, 'All that is called by My Name, and for My glory I created it, I formed it, and I made it' (Yeshayahu 43:7)."

872.label: Kiddushin 32b
872.rest: — "Rav Ashi said: Even according to the one who says that a nasi who forgoes his honor, his honor is forgone — a king who forgoes his honor, his honor is not forgone, as it says, 'You shall surely set a king over you' (Devarim 17:15): that his awe be upon you."

873.label: Zohar III 103a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Emor)
873.rest: — "'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' (Vayikra 23:42): this commandment is to dwell in the sukkah… to show that Israel dwell in the secret of faith without any fear, for the accuser has departed from them. And whoever is in the secret of faith sits in the sukkah, as it is written, 'Every native in Israel shall dwell in sukkos' — whoever is of the secret of faith, of the seed and root of Israel, shall dwell in sukkos."

874.label: Zohar III 103b (Emor)
874.rest: — "Rav Hamnuna Saba, when he entered the sukkah, would rejoice and stand at the door of the sukkah inside and say: Let us invite the guests, let us set the table. And he would stand and bless and say: 'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' — be seated, exalted guests, be seated; be seated, guests of faith, be seated."

875.label: Zohar Chadash, Toldos
875.rest: — Rosh Hashanah corresponds to Yitzchak, who was born on it, and we mention the Akeidah of Yitzchak; it is the day of judgment, corresponding to the attribute of judgment. Yom Kippur corresponds to Moshe, through whom the Holy One accepted prayer, pitied Israel and returned the Luchos. Sukkos corresponds to Aharon, in whose merit the seven Clouds went, covering Israel like sukkos; and therefore they make a sukkah.

876.label: Zohar III 255b (Ra'aya Meheimna, Pinchas)
876.rest: — "Sukkah written with the letter vav is in the secret of the two combinations, Havayah and Adnus, and so sukkah amounts in gematria to Yahadonahi…; 'sukkos' lacking the vav, of which it is said, 'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days,' is Imma."

877.label: Taanis 31a
877.rest: — "Ulla of Bira said in the name of Rabbi Elazar: In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will make a circle dance for the righteous, and He will sit among them in Gan Eden, and each one will point with his finger, as it says, 'And it shall be said on that day: Behold, this is our God; we hoped to Him and He saved us… let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation' (Yeshayahu 25:9)."

878.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a (Pasach Eliyahu)
878.rest: — "Kesser Elyon is the crown of kingship (Kesser Malchus), and of it is said, 'He declares the end from the beginning' (Yeshayahu 46:10); and it is the skull of the tefillin."

879.label: Rosh Hashanah 21b
879.rest: — "Rav and Shmuel both said: Fifty gates of understanding were created in the world, and all were given to Moshe except one, as it says, 'And You made him a little lower than God' (Tehillim 8:6)."

880.label: Sotah 12a
880.rest: — “The Sages say: When Moshe was born, the whole house filled with light. Here it is written, She saw that he was good; and there it is written, God saw the light, that it was good.” The association of good with light is explicit in the Gemara. Rav Tzadok reads Moshe's original spiritual portion through this image of light preceding encounter with evil.

881.label: Berachos 34b
881.rest: — "R. Abahu said: In the place where ba'alei teshuvah stand, the completely righteous cannot stand, as it says, 'Peace, peace, to the far and to the near' — the far first, then the near." This disputes R. Yochanan, who holds the completely righteous are greater. Rashi: "the near" is one who was far from sin all his days, a tzaddik from the start.

882.label: Zohar III 230a (Pinchas, Ra'aya Meheimna)
882.rest: — "He is truth (emes), and She is faith (emunah)."

883.label: Zohar III 104a (Emor)
883.rest: — "Let a person not say, I will first eat and be satisfied and drink, and what remains I will give to the poor; rather, the first of all belongs to the guests. And if he gladdens the guests and satisfies them, the Holy One rejoices with him, and Avraham recites over him, 'Then you shall delight in Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14), and Yitzchak recites over him, 'No weapon formed against you shall succeed' (Yeshayahu 54:17). Rabbi Shimon said: That is what David the King said of him, for all the King's weapons and wars were entrusted into David's hands; but Yitzchak says, 'His seed shall be mighty in the land… wealth and riches are in his house' (Tehillim 112:2–3)."

884.label: Zohar III 79b (Acharei Mos)
884.rest: — "It is written of Chanah, 'She prayed upon (al) Hashem' — 'upon' precisely, because children depend on the holy Mazal." And: "'Cast your burden upon (al) Hashem' — 'upon' precisely, for sustenance depends on Mazal."

885.label: Zohar II 54a
885.rest: — “When the light of the Holy Ancient One shines in His engraved, inscribed crowns … the Alef pierces the darkness and shines to every side.”

886.label: Zohar I 219a (Vayechi)
886.rest: — "'To behold the pleasantness of Hashem' (Tehillim 27:4) — this is the longing of the righteous… 'Then you shall delight al (above) Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14) — the pleasantness of Hashem that comes from the Holy Atika to these heavens. Fortunate is the portion of one who merits it; they are few."

887.label: Zohar I 129a (Chayei Sarah)
887.rest: — "When he grew old and entered the supernal levels as is fitting, as it is written, 'And Avraham was old,' then he 'came into days' — into those supernal days, the days known in the secret of faith; 'and Hashem blessed Avraham with everything (bakol)' — from where all blessings and all good issue."

888.label: Bava Metzia 87a
888.rest: — “Until Avraham there was no old age. One wishing to speak with Avraham would speak with Yitzchak; one wishing to speak with Yitzchak would speak with Avraham. Avraham came and asked for mercy, and old age came to be, as it says, 'Avraham was old, advanced in days.'” The Gemara explains the visible distinction of old age between father and son. Rav Tzadok reads this manifestation as the outward sign of Avraham's attainment of Atika; that mystical identification is his further interpretation.

889.label: Zohar I 26a (Bereishis)
889.rest: — "At that time it will be said of Moshe and Israel, 'Then you shall delight (tisaneg) upon Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14) — with oneg, which is ayin, Eden; nun, nahar (river); gimel, gan (garden)… and it will be turned for the Erev Rav, from oneg (delight) to nega (plague)."

890.label: Zohar II 205a (Vayakhel)
890.rest: — "This day is a day of souls and not a day of the body, for it is the dominion of the bundle of souls, and upper and lower beings all stand in one union, in the crown of the holy supernal additional spirit."

891.label: Sukkah 2a
891.rest: — "Rava said: From here: 'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' (Vayikra 23:42) — the Torah said: All seven days, leave your permanent dwelling and dwell in a temporary dwelling."

892.label: Tanna D'vei Eliyahu Rabbah 1
892.rest: — "From here they said: a person should rise early on Shabbos and learn, go to the synagogue and the study hall, read in the Torah and learn in the Prophets, and afterward go home and eat and drink… for the Holy One has rest only with those who toil in Torah, as it says, '…but to this one I will look: to the poor and broken in spirit, who trembles at My word' (Yeshayahu 66:2)."

893.label: Moed Katan 9b
893.rest: — "'May your house be destroyed and your lodging be settled' — this world is your lodging and that world is your house, as it is written, 'Their inner thought (kirbam) is that their houses are forever' (Tehillim 49:12) — do not read kirbam but kivram, their grave."

894.label: Tanchuma, Emor 22
894.rest: — "The Holy One said to Israel: In this world I told you to make a sukkah, to repay Me for the kindness I did with you, as it says, 'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days, so that your generations may know that I made the Children of Israel dwell in sukkos' (Vayikra 23:42–43); and I regard it as though you were doing kindness before Me."

895.label: Sukkah 28b (Mishnah)
895.rest: — "All seven days a person makes his sukkah permanent and his house temporary. If rain fell, from when is it permitted to leave? From when the porridge would spoil. A parable: to what is this comparable? To a servant who came to pour a cup for his master, and he poured a pitcher on his face."

896.label: Rosh Hashanah 16a
896.rest: — "Why did the Torah say to pour water on the festival? The Holy One said: Pour water before Me on the festival, so that the rains of the year be blessed for you. And say before Me on Rosh Hashanah Malchiyos, Zichronos and Shofaros: Malchiyos — so that you crown Me King over you; Zichronos — so that your remembrance rise before Me for good; and with what? With the shofar."

897.label: Berachos 17a
897.rest: — "When Rav Sheshes sat in a fast, after praying he would say: Master of the worlds, it is revealed before You that when the Beis HaMikdash stood, a person who sinned brought an offering, and only its fat and blood were offered, and he was atoned. Now I have sat in a fast and my fat and blood have diminished; may it be Your will that my diminished fat and blood be as though I had offered them before You on the altar."

898.label: Zohar III 7b (Vayikra)
898.rest: — “Therefore Israel sustain their Father in Heaven.”

899.label: Zohar III 104a (Emor)
899.rest: — "Let a person not say, I will first eat and be satisfied and drink, and what remains I will give to the poor; rather, the first of all belongs to the guests. And if he gladdens the guests and satisfies them, the Holy One rejoices with him, and Avraham recites over him, 'Then you shall delight in Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14), and Yitzchak recites over him, 'No weapon formed against you shall succeed' (Yeshayahu 54:17). Rabbi Shimon said: That is what David the King said of him, for all the King's weapons and wars were entrusted into David's hands; but Yitzchak says, 'His seed shall be mighty in the land… wealth and riches are in his house' (Tehillim 112:2–3)."

900.label: Berachos 28b
900.rest: — When R. Yochanan ben Zakkai fell ill, his students asked for a blessing. He said: "May it be [His] will that the fear of Heaven be upon you like the fear of flesh and blood." They said: "Only that much?" He said: "If only! Know that when a person sins, he says: Let no person see me." Rashi: would that you refrained from sin as you do before people. (Rav Tzadok attributes it to R. Eliezer.)

901.label: Chullin 16a
901.rest: — "From where do we know that slaughter is with something detached? As it says, 'And Avraham took the knife to slaughter' (Bereishis 22:10)… The verse comes to teach us the alacrity of Avraham."

902.label: Yoma 28b
902.rest: — "Rav Yosef said: Shall we arise and learn from Avraham? Rava said: The Tanna learned from Avraham, and we shall not learn from him? As it was taught: 'And on the eighth day he shall be circumcised' (Vayikra 12:3) — this teaches that the whole day is fit for milah, but the zealous hasten to mitzvos, as it says, 'And Avraham rose early in the morning' (Bereishis 22:3)."

903.label: Yoma 28b
903.rest: — "Avraham would pray [Minchah] as soon as the walls darkened… Shall we arise and learn from Avraham?" Rashi: to be zealous like Avraham.

904.label: Taanis 15a
904.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: I too say: not all are for light and not all are for gladness. The righteous are for light, and the upright for gladness: the righteous for light, as it is written, 'Light is sown for the righteous' (Tehillim 97:11); and the upright for gladness, as it is written, 'and for the upright of heart, gladness.'"

905.label: Sukkah 52b
905.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said: A person's inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him, as it says, 'The wicked one watches the righteous and seeks to kill him' (Tehillim 37:32); and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says, 'Hashem will not abandon him into his hand' (Tehillim 37:33)."

906.label: Eruvin 64a
906.rest: — "Rabbi Acha bar Chanina said: What is meant by 'But one who keeps company with harlots (ro'eh zonos) loses wealth' (Mishlei 29:3)? Whoever says, This teaching is fine (zo na'ah) and this one is not fine, loses the wealth of Torah." Rashi: its honor, and in the end it will be forgotten from him.

907.label: Yoma 72b
907.rest: — "Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'Why is there a price in the hand of a fool to acquire wisdom, when there is no heart (v'lev ayin)?' (Mishlei 17:16) — Woe to the enemies of Torah scholars [a euphemism for the scholars themselves] who toil in Torah but have no fear of Heaven." [Rashi does not comment on this line.]

908.label: Temurah 16a
908.rest: — "'The poor man and the man of means meet; Hashem lights up the eyes of both' (Mishlei 29:13): when the student goes to his teacher and says, Teach me Torah — if he teaches him, Hashem lights up the eyes of both; and if not, 'the rich and the poor meet; Hashem is the Maker of them all' (Mishlei 22:2) — He Who made this one wise makes him a fool, and the fool He makes wise."

909.label: Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 3
909.rest: — "He said to them: I am speaking of those rich in Torah, not those rich in money. How so? A great man, rich in Torah, who taught many students and spread Torah in public — even after he dies, the students he raised do not let him sleep, but sit and occupy themselves with Torah… and say halachos and teachings in his name."

910.label: Bava Basra 25b
910.rest: — "Rabbi Yitzchak said: One who wishes to become wise should face south, and one who wishes to become rich should face north; and your sign: the Table is in the north and the Menorah in the south." There also: "Out of the north comes gold" (Iyov 37:22).

911.label: Tanna D'vei Eliyahu Rabbah 3
911.rest: — "David the King further said: I feared out of my joy, and I rejoiced out of my fear, and my love rose above them all."

912.label: Taanis 15a
912.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: I too say: not all are for light and not all are for gladness. The righteous are for light, and the upright for gladness: the righteous for light, as it is written, 'Light is sown for the righteous' (Tehillim 97:11); and the upright for gladness, as it is written, 'and for the upright of heart, gladness.'"

913.label: Bava Metzia 33b
913.rest: — "'Declare to My people their transgression' (Yeshayahu 58:1) — these are Torah scholars, whose unintentional errors are counted as deliberate; 'and to the house of Yaakov their sins' — these are the amei ha'aretz, whose deliberate sins are counted as unintentional."

914.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 21, 46a
914.rest: — "And these that are added to the holy people on Erev Shabbos, Torah scholars inherit them on the weekdays, and through them the weekday is made holy."

915.label: Taanis 8b
915.rest: — "Rabbi Yitzchak said: Sun on Shabbos is charity for the poor, as it says, 'And for you who fear My Name a sun of righteousness shall shine, with healing in its wings' (Malachi 3:20)." Rashi explains "those who fear My Name" as those who keep the Shabbos.

916.label: Yerushalmi, Demai 4:1
916.rest: — "The awe of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz": on Shabbos even an unlearned person will not lie about whether his produce was tithed.

917.label: Zohar III 79b (Acharei Mos)
917.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: It is written, 'And it shall be, from one month to its month and from one Shabbos to its Shabbos' (Yeshayahu 66:23) — why weigh one against the other? Because all ascend to one level, one is joined to the other, and the joy of one with the other is found only when the Holy Atika is revealed; and then there is joy for all."

918.label: Zohar II 186b (Tetzaveh)
918.rest: — "When Israel are on the fifteenth day, He takes His children to spread His wings over them and to rejoice with them; therefore it is written, 'And you shall take for yourselves on the first day' (Vayikra 23:40). 'Fruit' — this is the tree called a fruit tree, and in it is found 'the fruit of a beautiful (hadar) tree,' as you say, 'Glory and splendor (hadar) are before Him' (Tehillim 96:6). Why is it called hadar, and who is hadar? This is Tzaddik."

919.label: Recanati, Parshas Emor
919.rest: — The three hadassim allude to the three supernal Avos, "and these and these are the words of the living God"; and the esrog alludes to the Shechinah, and therefore it is held in the left, for from there she receives; and it is shaped like the heart.

920.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction (2b)
920.rest: — "The three hadassim allude to the three Avos, the two willow branches to the two true prophets, the lulav to the Tzaddik — 'the righteous will flourish like a palm' (Tehillim 92:13); the esrog alludes to the Shechinah, and the sukkah alludes to Imma, who shelters over them."

921.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a
921.rest: — “You brought forth ten arrangements, and we call them ten sefirot, through which to direct concealed worlds that are not revealed and worlds that are revealed. ... Malkhut is the mouth: we call it Oral Torah.” The specific formula “Malkhut is the mouth, Oral Torah” is found in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar, in Patach Eliyahu. It complements the preceding Zohar passage about the seventh day.

922.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 243b (Pinchas)
922.rest: — "The Shechinah is called the land (eretz) of the Holy One, as it is written, 'And the earth is My footstool' (Yeshayahu 66:1). From the side of Chesed she is called water, from the side of Gevurah fire, from the side of the middle pillar air; and she is the earth, the ground of them all."

923.label: Zohar II 178b (Sifra DiTzniusa)
923.rest: — "The hei was a dalet at first; and once it was impregnated with the yud within it, it gave birth and brought forth the vav."

924.label: Zohar III 103b (Emor)
924.rest: — "Rav Hamnuna Saba, when he entered the sukkah, would rejoice and stand at the door of the sukkah inside and say: Let us invite the guests, let us set the table. And he would stand and bless and say: 'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' — be seated, exalted guests, be seated; be seated, guests of faith, be seated."

925.label: Nedarim 20a
925.rest: — "'So that His fear may be upon your faces' (Shemos 20:17) — this is shame; 'that you not sin' — this teaches that shame leads to fear of sin. From here they said: It is a good sign in a person that he is bashful. Others say: Whoever is ashamed will not quickly sin, and one who has no shamefacedness — it is certain that his forefathers did not stand at Mount Sinai."

926.label: Sefer Yetzirah 6
926.rest: — "The heart in the soul is like a king in war."

927.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
927.rest: — "As Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'The utterance of David son of Yishai, and the utterance of the man raised on high (hukam al)' (II Shmuel 23:1)? The utterance of David son of Yishai, who raised up the yoke (ullah) of teshuvah."

928.label: Zohar III, Pinchas (Ra'aya Meheimna)
928.rest: — "The Holy One, blessed be He, is hidden in the secrets of the Torah. How is He known? Through the mitzvos, which are His Shechinah, His image: as He is humble, His Shechinah is humility; He is pious and she is piety…; He is truth (emes) and she is faith (emunah); He is righteous and she is righteousness; He is King and she is kingship."

929.label: Yalkut Shimoni, Emor 654 (from the Pesikta)
929.rest: — "You find three rejoicings written of the festival [of Sukkos]: 'And you shall rejoice in your festival,' 'And you shall be only joyful,' 'And you shall rejoice before Hashem your God seven days'; but of Pesach you do not find even one rejoicing written."

930.label: Sukkah 48a
930.rest: — "From where are these words? As our Rabbis taught: 'And you shall be only (ach) joyful' (Devarim 16:15) — to include the night of the last Yom Tov of the festival."

931.label: Midrash Tanchuma, Pinchas 15
931.rest: — “It would have been fitting for the assembly after Sukkos to be fifty days after the festival, just as the assembly after Pesach is fifty days later. But the Holy One, blessed be He, said: ‘It is winter, and they cannot leave their homes to come here. Instead, while they are with Me, let them hold the assembly.’” The Midrash explains Shemini Atzeres by the difficulty of returning in winter. Rav Tzadok invokes this as an example of the burden of travel in the present order of things.

932.label: Pesikta D'Rav Kahana, supplement for Sukkos
932.rest: — "Why do we make sukkos after Yom Kippur? For if they were liable to exile, the Holy One accounts it to them as if they had been exiled to Babylon."

933.label: Yerushalmi, Yoma 1:1
933.rest: — "Every generation in whose days it [the Beis HaMikdash] is not built is regarded as though it was destroyed in its days."

934.label: Chagigah 13a
934.rest: — "…nor the Chariot to an individual. Rabbi Chiya taught: But one may transmit to him the chapter headings. Rabbi Zeira said: One transmits the chapter headings only to the head of a court and to one whose heart is anxious within him."

935.label: Sukkah 20a
935.rest: — "In the beginning, when the Torah was forgotten from Israel, Ezra came up from Bavel and established it; it was again forgotten, and Hillel the Babylonian came up and established it; again forgotten, and R. Chiya and his sons came up and established it."

936.label: Tanchuma, Noach 3
936.rest: — "Therefore the Holy One established two yeshivos for Israel, to toil in Torah day and night, gathering twice a year, in Adar and in Elul, from every place, debating in the battle of Torah until they establish a matter clearly and the halachah according to its truth."

937.label: Kesubos 110b
937.rest: — "Rabbi Zeira would avoid Rav Yehudah, because he wished to go up to Eretz Yisrael; for Rav Yehudah said: Whoever goes up from Bavel to Eretz Yisrael transgresses a positive commandment, as it says, 'They shall be carried to Bavel, and there they shall be, until the day that I remember them' (Yirmeyahu 27:22)."

938.label: Yoma 9b
938.rest: — Reish Lakish said to the Babylonians: "God hates you! For it is written, 'If she is a wall, we will build upon her a turret of silver' (Shir HaShirim 8:9) — had you made yourselves like a wall and all gone up in the days of Ezra, you would have been compared to silver."

939.label: Zohar III 103a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Emor)
939.rest: — "'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' (Vayikra 23:42): this commandment is to dwell in the sukkah… to show that Israel dwell in the secret of faith without any fear, for the accuser has departed from them. And whoever is in the secret of faith sits in the sukkah, as it is written, 'Every native in Israel shall dwell in sukkos' — whoever is of the secret of faith, of the seed and root of Israel, shall dwell in sukkos."

940.label: Chagigah 3a
940.rest: — "Rava expounded: What is meant by 'How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O daughter of the noble (bas nadiv)' (Shir HaShirim 7:2)? How beautiful are the feet of Israel when they go up for the festival! 'Daughter of the noble' — the daughter of Avraham Avinu, who is called noble, as it says, 'The nobles of the nations are gathered, the people of the God of Avraham' (Tehillim 47:10) — the God of Avraham and not the God of Yitzchak and Yaakov? Rather, the God of Avraham, who was the first of the converts."

942.label: Zohar III 104a (Emor)
942.rest: — "Let a person not say, I will first eat and be satisfied and drink, and what remains I will give to the poor; rather, the first of all belongs to the guests. And if he gladdens the guests and satisfies them, the Holy One rejoices with him, and Avraham recites over him, 'Then you shall delight in Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14), and Yitzchak recites over him, 'No weapon formed against you shall succeed' (Yeshayahu 54:17). Rabbi Shimon said: That is what David the King said of him, for all the King's weapons and wars were entrusted into David's hands; but Yitzchak says, 'His seed shall be mighty in the land… wealth and riches are in his house' (Tehillim 112:2–3)."

943.label: Zohar II 88a (Yisro)
943.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: Whoever completes three meals on Shabbos, a voice goes out and proclaims of him: 'Then you shall delight in Hashem' — this is one meal, corresponding to the holy Atika of all holy ones; 'I will make you ride on the high places of the earth' — the second meal, corresponding to the Field of holy Apples…"

944.label: Tosafos, Shabbos 130a (s.v. sas anochi)
944.rest: — "'The eighth' is written, expounded about milah, which is on the eighth day; and so they said (Pirkei D'Rabbi Eliezer 29): 'And Avraham made a great feast on the day Yitzchak was weaned (hi-gamel)' — on the day he circumcised (hei-gimel mal) Yitzchak, that is the eighth day of milah, the numerical value of hei-gimel." (Rabbeinu Tam)

945.label: Kiddushin 18a
945.rest: — "Rav Chiya bar Avin said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: An idolater inherits his father by Torah law, as it is written, 'For I have given Mount Seir to Esav as an inheritance' (Devarim 2:5). But perhaps an apostate Jew is different! Rather, from here: 'For I have given Ar to the children of Lot as an inheritance' (Devarim 2:9)."

946.label: Sukkah 5b
