946.rest: — The cherubim are described as having "a large face and a small face" (apei ravrevei ve'apei zutrei).

947.label: Zohar III 98b (Emor)
947.rest: — "'In the seventh month, on the first of the month' (Vayikra 23:24): Rabbi Yitzchak opened: 'Blow the shofar at the new moon, at the covered time for our festival day' (Tehillim 81:4). Fortunate are Israel, for the Holy One drew them near to Him out of all the idolatrous nations and chose them, and from a distant place He drew them near, as it is written, 'Your fathers dwelt of old beyond the River' (Yehoshua 24:2) — to show that from a distant place He chose them and drew them near."

948.label: Berachos 17a
948.rest: — "Rabbi Alexandri, after his prayer, would say: Master of the worlds, it is revealed and known before You that our will is to do Your will; and who holds us back? The leaven in the dough and the subjugation to the kingdoms." Rashi: the leaven in the dough — the evil inclination in our hearts, which sours us.

949.label: Zohar III 104a (Emor)
949.rest: — "Let a person not say, I will first eat and be satisfied and drink, and what remains I will give to the poor; rather, the first of all belongs to the guests. And if he gladdens the guests and satisfies them, the Holy One rejoices with him, and Avraham recites over him, 'Then you shall delight in Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14), and Yitzchak recites over him, 'No weapon formed against you shall succeed' (Yeshayahu 54:17). Rabbi Shimon said: That is what David the King said of him, for all the King's weapons and wars were entrusted into David's hands; but Yitzchak says, 'His seed shall be mighty in the land… wealth and riches are in his house' (Tehillim 112:2–3)."

950.label: Avos 4:1
950.rest: — "Ben Zoma says: Who is wise? One who learns from every person… Who is mighty? One who conquers his inclination, as it says, 'Better is one slow to anger than a mighty man, and one who rules his spirit than one who captures a city' (Mishlei 16:32)."

951.label: Rashi, Bereishis 26:13
951.rest: — "'And the man grew great' — for they would say: the dung of Yitzchak's mules, and not the silver and gold of Avimelech."

952.label: Bava Basra 25b
952.rest: — "Rabbi Yitzchak said: One who wishes to become wise should face south, and one who wishes to become rich should face north; and your sign: the Table is in the north and the Menorah in the south." There also: "Out of the north comes gold" (Iyov 37:22).

953.label: Pesachim 2a
953.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: A person should always enter [a place] with 'ki tov' (while it is good — by daylight) and leave with 'ki tov.'"

954.label: Yerushalmi, Pe'ah 1:1
954.rest: — "'For Hashem will be your trust (kislecha), and He will guard your foot from capture' (Mishlei 3:26) — even in matters in which you are foolish (kesil)… Rabbi Abba said: If you gave charity from your pocket (kis), the Holy One guards you from fines and levies."

955.label: Pesachim 119b
955.rest: — "Rav Avira expounded: What is meant by 'And the child grew and was weaned (vayigamal)' (Bereishis 21:8)? In the future the Holy One will make a feast for the righteous on the day that He bestows (yigmol) His kindness upon the seed of Yitzchak. After they eat and drink, they give Avraham Avinu the cup of blessing to bless."

956.label: Tanchuma, Shemini 7
956.rest: — "For in the future the Holy One will make a feast for the righteous from the Behemoth and the Leviasan, and there is no slaughter there."

957.label: Bava Basra 75a
957.rest: — "Rabbah said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: In the future the Holy One will make a feast for the righteous from the flesh of the Leviasan, as it says, 'Companions (chaverim) shall make a feast (yichru) over him' (Iyov 40:30); and 'kerah' means only a feast…, and 'chaverim' means only Torah scholars."

958.label: Zohar I 137a–138a (Midrash HaNe'elam, Toldos)
958.rest: — "'The sister of Lavan' — the sister of the evil inclination. At first, when it was disgraced with sins in this world, it was called Lot; in the time to come, when it will no longer be disgraced as before, like one who bathes and immerses himself from his impurity, it is called Lavan (white)."

959.label: Avodah Zarah 2b
959.rest: — "The Holy One says to them: With what did you occupy yourselves? They say before Him: Master of the world, we established many marketplaces, built many bathhouses, amassed much silver and gold — and we did it all only for the sake of Israel, so that they could occupy themselves with Torah."

960.label: Berachos 6b
960.rest: — "Rabbi Abba bar Kahana said: This one is equal to the whole world. Rabbi Shimon ben Azzai — some say Rabbi Shimon ben Zoma — said: The whole world was created only to accompany this one."

961.label: Berachos 58a
961.rest: — "Ben Zoma saw a crowd on a step of the Temple Mount and said: Blessed is the Wise One of secrets, and blessed is He Who created all these to serve me."

962.label: Bava Basra 74b–75a
962.rest: — "In the future Gavriel will make a hunt of the Leviasan, as it says, 'Can you draw out the Leviasan with a hook?' (Iyov 40:25); and were it not that the Holy One helps him, he could not prevail over it, as it says, 'He that made him can bring near His sword' (40:19)."

963.label: Sukkah 52b
963.rest: — "Reish Lakish said: A person's inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him… and were it not for the Holy One, blessed is He, Who helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says, 'Hashem will not abandon him into his hand' (Tehillim 37:33)." Rashi: "every day" — its evil increases daily.

964.label: Sukkah 52a
964.rest: — "Rabbi Yehudah expounded: In the time to come the Holy One will bring the evil inclination and slaughter it before the righteous and before the wicked. To the righteous it appears like a high mountain, and to the wicked like a hairsbreadth. These weep and those weep: the righteous weep and say, How were we able to conquer such a high mountain! … And Abaye said: Whoever is greater than his fellow, his inclination is greater than he."

965.label: Zohar III 100b (Emor)
965.rest: — "Then Esav, Yaakov's guardian, turned back… 'So Esav returned that day on his way to Seir' (Bereishis 33:16) — when? At the time of Ne'ilah, for he departed from the holy people, and the Holy One forgave their sins and atoned for them. Once that accuser went off with that gift and departed from them, the Holy One wished to rejoice with His children. What is written? 'And Yaakov journeyed to Sukkos' (33:17)… once they sit in sukkos, they are saved from the accuser."

966.label: Zohar III 103a (Emor)
966.rest: — Since Canaan (Eliezer) merited to serve Avraham, he sat under the shade of faith and merited to leave the curse with which he had been cursed; for whoever sits in the shade of faith inherits freedom for himself and his children.

967.label: Bava Basra 16b–17a
967.rest: — "Three were given a taste of the World to Come in this world: Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov — Avraham, of whom it is written 'with all' (bakol, Bereishis 24:1); Yitzchak, of whom it is written 'of all' (mikol, 27:33); Yaakov, of whom it is written 'all' (kol, 33:11)."

968.label: Zohar I 162a–b (Vayeitzei, Sisrei Torah)
968.rest: — "'And he set aside flocks for himself alone, and did not put them with Lavan's flocks' (Bereishis 30:40): those flocks he set apart for himself, so that he would have no share with the other nations."

969.label: Zohar II 188b (Ki Sisa)
969.rest: — "Had the verse said, 'The lip of truth was established forever,' it would be as you said; but it is written only 'shall be established' (tikon) — the lip of truth is destined to be established, which is not so now: for now the lip of falsehood stands and the lip of truth lies in the dust; and at that time, when truth will stand in its place and sprout from the earth, then the lip of truth shall be established forever."

970.label: Sukkah 11b
970.rest: — "'For I made the Children of Israel dwell in sukkos' (Vayikra 23:43) — they were Clouds of Glory; the words of Rabbi Eliezer. Rabbi Akiva says: They made themselves actual sukkos."

971.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 36, 77b
971.rest: — "Two thousand years of tohu — 'and the earth was tohu'; two thousand of Torah — 'and the spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters' (Bereishis 1:2), and water means nothing but Torah; 'the face of the waters' — its two faces, the positive and the negative commandments, white and red, right and left… 'Let there be light' — this is Pesach, the light of the fourteenth; 'and there was light' — this is Rosh Hashanah."

972.label: Zohar II 52b (Beshalach)
972.rest: — "Rabbi Yitzchak said: Then, when everything was illuminated as one, the sea performed supernal laws, and upper and lower were delivered into its hand; therefore all is as hard before the Holy One as the splitting of the Red Sea. Why? Because the splitting of the Red Sea depends on Atika."

973.label: Rashi, Genesis 1:1, s.v. Bereishis Bara
973.rest: — “As our Sages expounded: For the sake of the Torah, which is called 'the beginning of His way,' and for the sake of Israel, who are called 'the beginning of His produce.'” Rashi's two readings of bereishis underlie the claim that Creation's purpose is bound to Torah and Israel. The Sinai condition discussed in Shabbos 88a then gives that purpose its explicit covenantal form.

974.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction (2b)
974.rest: — "The three hadassim allude to the three Avos, the two willow branches to the two true prophets, the lulav to the Tzaddik — 'the righteous will flourish like a palm' (Tehillim 92:13); the esrog alludes to the Shechinah, and the sukkah alludes to Imma, who shelters over them."

975.label: Berachos 34b
975.rest: — "R. Abahu said: In the place where ba'alei teshuvah stand, the completely righteous cannot stand, as it says, 'Peace, peace, to the far and to the near' — the far first, then the near." This disputes R. Yochanan, who holds the completely righteous are greater. Rashi: "the near" is one who was far from sin all his days, a tzaddik from the start.

976.label: Avodah Zarah 17a
976.rest: — "Rebbi wept and said: There is one who acquires his world in many years, and there is one who acquires his world in a single hour. And Rebbi said: It is not enough for penitents that they are accepted — they are even called 'Rabbi.'"

977.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13 (29a)
977.rest: — "When the sukkah was completed in its thigh, it is said of Yaakov, 'And Yaakov came whole': Yaakov is surely the image of the central pillar from the outside. But was not Moshe there? Rather, he was from the inside — this one from the body, that one from the soul." Matok MiDvash: Yaakov is the chariot of Tiferes's body, Moshe of its soul.

978.label: Bereishis Rabbah 63:8
978.rest: — "'And they called his name Esav' — here is the vanity (ha shav) that I created in My world."

979.label: Gittin 56a
979.rest: — "He said to a child: Recite your verse to me. He said to him: 'And I will lay My vengeance upon Edom by the hand of My people Israel' (Yechezkel 25:14). He said: The Holy One wishes to destroy His House, and wishes to wipe His hands on that man. He fled and converted, and Rabbi Meir descended from him."

980.label: Megillah 16a
980.rest: — "'And Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and to all his friends… and his wise men said to him' (Esther 6:13) — it calls them his friends and it calls them his wise men. Rabbi Yochanan said: Whoever says a word of wisdom, even among the nations of the world, is called wise."

981.label: Eichah Rabbah 2:13
981.rest: — "If a person tells you there is wisdom among the nations, believe it, as it says, 'And I will destroy the wise men from Edom' (Ovadiah 1:8); if he tells you there is Torah among the nations, do not believe it, as it says, 'Her king and her princes are among the nations; there is no Torah' (Eichah 2:9)."

982.label: Chullin 91a
982.rest: — "Rav Shmuel bar Acha said before Rav Pappa in the name of Rava bar Ulla: He appeared to him as a Torah scholar."

983.label: Shabbos 118b
983.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi said: In all my days I never called my wife 'my wife' or my ox 'my ox,' but my wife 'my home' and my ox 'my field.'" Rashi: she is the essence of the home, and the ox the essence of the field.

984.label: Shabbos 33b
984.rest: — "'And Yaakov came whole (shalem)' (Bereishis 33:18) — Rav said: whole in his body, whole in his money, whole in his Torah."

985.label: Zohar I 122b (Tosefta, Chayei Sarah)
985.rest: — "Fortunate is he who makes himself small in this world — how great and exalted he is in that world! And so the head of the yeshivah opened: Whoever is small is great, and whoever is great is small."

986.label: Yevamos 61a
986.rest: — "The graves of idolaters do not defile in a tent, as it says, 'And you, My flock, the flock of My pasture, you are adam' (Yechezkel 34:31) — you are called adam, and idolaters are not called adam."

987.label: Daas Zekeinim, Bereishis 25:25
987.rest: — When his father saw that he was ruddy, he said: his blood has not yet been absorbed, and did not want to circumcise him at eight days… When a year or two passed and Yitzchak saw that he did not change, he knew this was his nature; still he did not circumcise him, saying: I will wait until he is thirteen, like Yishmael my brother; and at thirteen Esav himself refused.

988.label: Kiddushin 18a
988.rest: — "Rav Chiya bar Avin said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: An idolater inherits his father by Torah law, as it is written, 'For I have given Mount Seir to Esav as an inheritance' (Devarim 2:5). But perhaps an apostate Jew is different! Rather, from here: 'For I have given Ar to the children of Lot as an inheritance' (Devarim 2:9)."

989.label: Zohar II 88b (Yisro)
989.rest: — Rabbi Shimon said: Whoever completes the three meals on Shabbos, a voice goes out and proclaims of him: "Then you shall delight in Hashem" — this is the first meal…; "and I will feed you the inheritance of Yaakov your father" (Yeshayahu 58:14) — this is the completion, completed in Ze'eir Anpin.

990.label: Shabbos 118b
990.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: Whoever gives delight to the Shabbos is granted the wishes of his heart, as it says, 'Delight in Hashem, and He will give you the wishes of your heart' (Tehillim 37:4). This delight — I do not know what it is; when it says, 'And you shall call the Shabbos a delight' (Yeshayahu 58:13), it is the delight of Shabbos." Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: he is saved from the subjugation of the exiles.

991.label: Tanchuma, Ki Seitzei 10
991.rest: — "What would the house of Amalek do? They would cut off the circumcisions of Israel and throw them upward and say: This is what You chose — take what You chose."

992.label: Zohar II 23a (Va'era)
992.rest: — "Whoever is circumcised inherits the land, for only a tzaddik inherits the land, and whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik, as it is written, 'And your people are all righteous; they shall inherit the land forever' (Yeshayahu 60:21)."

993.label: Bava Basra 123b
993.rest: — “Rabbi Chelbo asked Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani: ‘When Rachel had borne Yosef’—what changed when Yosef was born? He answered: Yaakov our father saw that Esav’s offspring are delivered only into the hands of Yosef’s offspring, as it says, ‘The house of Yaakov will be fire, the house of Yosef a flame, and the house of Esav straw.’” The Gemara explains Yaakov’s readiness to leave Lavan after Yosef’s birth. Rav Tzadok describes the moral reversal that makes Yosef the opposing force to Esav.

994.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 255b (Pinchas)
994.rest: — "'And a sukkah shall be for shade by day' (Yeshayahu 4:6): we require s'chach, and the s'chach is made for shade… not the shade of an ordinary sukkah, which protects the body from the sun, but a shade to protect the soul: 'In his shade I delighted and sat' (Shir HaShirim 2:3)."

995.label: Shabbos 146a
995.rest: — “When the serpent came upon Chavah, it cast impurity into her. Israel, who stood at Mount Sinai, had their impurity cease; the nations, who did not stand at Mount Sinai, did not have their impurity cease. Rav Acha son of Rava asked Rav Ashi: What of converts? He answered: Though they themselves were not there, their heavenly counterparts were present, as it is written, ‘With those who stand here with us today before Hashem our God, and with those who are not here with us today.’”

996.label: Zohar Chadash, Vayeshev
996.rest: — When Yaakov saw the seven supernal years agreed upon to be famine in the world "for the sin that his sons caused by selling this holy tzaddik and removing him from his place," he prayed and five years were removed; and the reckoning of the years of exile is counted against the ten who sold him.

997.label: Chagigah 10b
997.rest: — "Perhaps the Merciful One said 'chogu chaga' (celebrate a festival)!" Rashi: chogu chaga — to increase rejoicing.

998.label: Kesubos 17a
998.rest: — "They said of Rabbi Yehudah bar Ilai that he would take a myrtle branch and dance before the bride… Rav Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak would dance juggling three. Rabbi Zeira said: The old man embarrasses us. When he died, a pillar of fire separated between him and the whole world."

999.label: Sukkah 48a
999.rest: — "From where are these words? As our Rabbis taught: 'And you shall be only (ach) joyful' (Devarim 16:15) — to include the night of the last Yom Tov of the festival."

1000.label: Taanis 15a
1000.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: I too say: not all are for light and not all are for gladness. The righteous are for light, and the upright for gladness: the righteous for light, as it is written, 'Light is sown for the righteous' (Tehillim 97:11); and the upright for gladness, as it is written, 'and for the upright of heart, gladness.'"

1001.label: Taanis 9a
1001.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi bar Yehudah says: Three good providers arose for Israel: Moshe, Aharon and Miriam; and three good gifts were given through them: the well, the cloud and the manna. The well in the merit of Miriam, the pillar of cloud in the merit of Aharon, the manna in the merit of Moshe. When Miriam died the well departed… and it returned in the merit of both."

1002.label: Shabbos 86b
1002.rest: — “The Rabbis taught: On the sixth of the month the Ten Commandments were given to Israel; Rabbi Yosei says, on its seventh. Rava said: All agree that they came to the wilderness of Sinai on Rosh Chodesh. ... And all agree that the Torah was given to Israel on Shabbos. ... Their dispute concerns the fixing of the month.”

1003.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a (Pasach Eliyahu)
1003.rest: — "Chesed is the right arm, Gevurah the left arm, Tiferes the body, Netzach and Hod the two thighs, Yesod the completion of the body, the sign of the holy covenant; Malchus is the mouth — we call it the Oral Torah."

1004.label: Sukkah 26a
1004.rest: — "Rava said: One who is distressed is exempt from the sukkah."

1005.label: Pesikta D'Rav Kahana, supplement for Sukkos
1005.rest: — "Why do we make sukkos after Yom Kippur? For if they were liable to exile, the Holy One accounts it to them as if they had been exiled to Babylon."

1006.label: Zohar II 2b (Shemos)
1006.rest: — "When they went down to Babylon the heavens opened and holy prophecy rested on Yechezkel… He told Israel: Your Master is here, with all the hosts of heaven… They did not believe him until he had to reveal all he saw… When Israel heard, they did not fear their exile at all, for they knew the Holy One had not abandoned them; and all he revealed, he revealed with permission."

1007.label: Eruvin 21b
1007.rest: — “‘New as well as old, my beloved, I have stored away for you’: The congregation of Israel said before the Holy One, blessed be He: Master of the world, I have imposed many decrees upon myself beyond what You decreed upon me, and I have fulfilled them.” The additional decrees are presented as Israel’s loving offering. The maamar contrasts that motive with Haman’s accusation that separation comes from pride or hatred.

1008.label: Avos 1:2
1008.rest: — "Shimon HaTzaddik was of the remnants of the Men of the Great Assembly. He used to say: On three things the world stands: on Torah, on avodah, and on acts of kindness."

1009.label: Pirkei Avot 1:1
1009.rest: — “Moses received Torah from Sinai and transmitted it to Joshua; Joshua to the elders; the elders to the prophets; and the prophets transmitted it to the Men of the Great Assembly. They said three things: Be deliberate in judgment, raise up many students, and make a fence for Torah.” The transmission culminates in the assembly whose program Rav Tzadok invokes: the expansion of students and the protection of Torah through a fence.

1010.label: Midrash Tanchuma, Noach 3
1010.rest: — “Israel did not accept the Torah until the Holy One, blessed be He, held the mountain over them like a barrel.” The Tanchuma ties this coercion to the Oral Torah.

1011.label: Kesubos 110b
1011.rest: — "Rabbi Zeira would avoid Rav Yehudah, because he wished to go up to Eretz Yisrael; for Rav Yehudah said: Whoever goes up from Bavel to Eretz Yisrael transgresses a positive commandment, as it says, 'They shall be carried to Bavel, and there they shall be, until the day that I remember them' (Yirmeyahu 27:22)."

1012.label: Sukkah 52a
1012.rest: — "Shlomo called [the evil inclination] 'enemy,' as it says, 'If your enemy is hungry, feed him bread' (Mishlei 25:21)."

1013.label: Yoma 28b
1013.rest: — "Rav said: Avraham Avinu fulfilled the entire Torah, as it says, 'Because Avraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes and My Torahs' (Bereishis 26:5). Rav Shimi bar Chiya said to Rav: Perhaps only the seven mitzvos? — There was milah too! — Perhaps seven and milah? — If so, why 'My commandments and My Torahs'?"

1014.label: Berachos 5b
1014.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

1015.label: Chagigah 3a
1015.rest: — "Rava expounded: What is meant by 'How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O daughter of the noble (bas nadiv)' (Shir HaShirim 7:2)? How beautiful are the feet of Israel when they go up for the festival! 'Daughter of the noble' — the daughter of Avraham Avinu, who is called noble, as it says, 'The nobles of the nations are gathered, the people of the God of Avraham' (Tehillim 47:10) — the God of Avraham and not the God of Yitzchak and Yaakov? Rather, the God of Avraham, who was the first of the converts."

1017.label: Zohar I, Mikeitz 202a
1017.rest: — “We learned: A person should always rouse the good inclination against the evil inclination and strive against it. If it departs from him, well; if not, he should occupy himself with Torah, for there is nothing that breaks the evil inclination except Torah. If it departs, good; if not, let him remind it of the day of death in order to break it.” The Zohar gives a sequence of active resistance, Torah and remembrance of death. Rav Tzadok emphasizes the Oral Torah's lived study as the means of transforming the inward enemy.

1018.label: Zohar I 5b, Introduction
1018.rest: — “Another Shabbos remained unmentioned and was ashamed. She said before Him: ‘Master of the world, from the day You made me I have been called Shabbos, yet there is no day without night.’ He said to her: ‘My daughter, you are Shabbos and I call you Shabbos, but I now crown you with a higher crown.’ He issued a proclamation: ‘My Sanctuary you shall fear.’ This is the Shabbos of Shabbos eve, which is fear, and fear rests within her.” The passage’s 5b marker precedes this teaching, and 6a follows it. The sanctity of Shabbos night is expressly joined to reverence, explaining its relation to the guarding aspect of Malchus.

1019.label: Yoma 86a
1019.rest: — "Rabbi Levi said: Great is repentance, for it reaches up to the Throne of Glory, as it says, 'Return, Israel, unto (ad) Hashem your God' (Hoshea 14:2)." Rashi has no comment on this line.

1020.label: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 258a (Pinchas)
1020.rest: — "The tefillin of the Master of the world are Keser. And what is the Keser of the Master of the world? Havayah: yud is Chochmah, hei is Binah, vav is Tiferes, comprising six sefiros, and hei is Malchus." The four letters span the nine middos, and Keser above them is alluded to only in the upper tip of the yud.

1021.label: Zohar III 65b (Acharei Mos)
1021.rest: — "Come and see: the yud at first is the totality of all, hidden on every side, its paths not yet opened, the totality of male and female. The tip (kotz) of the upper yud alludes to Ayin [Keser]. Afterward the yud brings forth that river which flows out of it."

1022.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
1022.rest: — "On Rosh Hashanah the servitude of our fathers in Egypt ceased; in Nissan they were redeemed, and in Tishrei they are destined to be redeemed" — the view of Rabbi Eliezer, who derives that the world was created in Tishrei from "Let the earth sprout grass… fruit tree" (Bereishis 1:11).

1023.label: Zohar I, Addenda
1023.rest: — "Come and see: the ten saplings, the willow and the water libation are a halachah given to Moshe at Sinai. Other matters of the Torah are called 'Torah,' and here 'halachah' — why? Because this place called Mount Sinai, the Oral Torah, taught it to Moshe, to tie the knots of faith."

1024.label: Zohar I, Hashmatos 261b
1024.rest: — "Come and see: on this festival they perform the water libation, a spring of Chesed, in those shafts (shitin) from the six days of Creation; and all the seven supernal days receive from those living waters that flow forth from the hidden supernal Jerusalem."

1025.label: Bava Basra 12b
1025.rest: — "Rav Ashi said: Know it, for a great man says something, and then a halachah given to Moshe at Sinai is stated in accordance with him. — But perhaps he is like a blind man at a window, and gives no reason!"

1026.label: Pirkei Avot 1:1
1026.rest: — “Moses received Torah from Sinai and transmitted it to Joshua; Joshua to the elders; the elders to the prophets; and the prophets transmitted it to the Men of the Great Assembly. They said three things: Be deliberate in judgment, raise up many students, and make a fence for Torah.” The transmission culminates in the assembly whose program Rav Tzadok invokes: the expansion of students and the protection of Torah through a fence.

1027.label: Bava Metzia 115a
1027.rest: — "Shall we say that Rabbi Yehudah does not expound the reason of the verse and Rabbi Shimon expounds the reason of the verse?" — Rabbi Shimon's known method is to expound the reasons behind the Torah's commandments.

1028.label: Zohar II, Beshalach 64b
1028.rest: — “Rabbi Abba said: What is meant by ‘Is the Lord in our midst, or nothing?’ Were Israel fools who did not know this matter? Had they not seen the Divine Presence before them and the clouds of glory surrounding them? ... Rather, Rabbi Shimon said this: They wished to know the difference between the Ancient One, concealed beyond all concealment, who is called Nothing, and Zeir Anpin, who is called the Lord. ... Why, then, were they punished? Because they made a separation and put it to a test. They said: If it is this One, we will ask in one manner; if it is this One, we will ask in another manner. Therefore, immediately, ‘Amalek came.’” The Zohar interprets Israel's question at Massah as a question about the degree from which Divine governance was being revealed. It explicitly names the concealed Atika as Ayin.

1029.label: Shabbos 67a
1029.rest: — "And let him say thus: O bush, O bush — not because you are taller than all trees did the Holy One rest His Shechinah upon you, but because you are lower than all trees did the Holy One rest His Shechinah upon you."

1030.label: Megillah 29a
1030.rest: — "'Why do you leap, you mountains of peaks' (Tehillim 68:17)? A heavenly voice went forth and said to them: Why do you seek judgment with Sinai? You are all blemished compared to Sinai."

1031.label: Berachos 58a
1031.rest: — "'And the netzach' — this is the downfall of Rome, as it says, 'Their lifeblood (nitzcham) spattered upon My garments' (Yeshayahu 63:3)."

1032.label: Tikkunei Zohar
1032.rest: — Eighteen shakings [of the lulav] corresponding to the eighteen vertebrae of the spine on the side of the body; and all this is from the side of the Tree of Life.

1033.label: Avodah Zarah 9a
1033.rest: — "It was taught in the school of Eliyahu: The world is to exist for six thousand years: two thousand years of tohu, two thousand years of Torah, two thousand years the days of Mashiach." The Gemara reckons the two thousand years of Torah from Avraham's time in Charan.

1034.label: Rashi, Bereishis 37:3
1034.rest: — "'Ben zekunim' — for he was born to him in his old age. And Onkelos rendered it 'a wise son': all that he had learned from Shem and Ever he transmitted to him."

1035.label: Kiddushin 32b
1035.rest: — "'Before the hoary head you shall rise, and honor the face of the elder (zaken)' (Vayikra 19:32)… Rabbi Yosi HaGelili says: A zaken is none other than one who has acquired wisdom, as it says, 'Hashem acquired me at the beginning of His way' (Mishlei 8:22)."

1036.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a (Pasach Eliyahu)
1036.rest: — "Chesed is the right arm, Gevurah the left arm, Tiferes the body, Netzach and Hod the two thighs, Yesod the completion of the body, the sign of the holy covenant; Malchus is the mouth — we call it the Oral Torah."

1037.label: Berachos 17a
1037.rest: — "Master of the world, it is revealed and known before You that our will is to do Your will. And what prevents it? The leaven in the dough and subjugation to the kingdoms."

1038.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13, 29a
1038.rest: — "When the sukkah is complete, it is said of Yaakov, 'And Yaakov came whole' (Bereishis 33:18); and Yaakov is certainly the image of the middle pillar from the outside. But was not Moshe there? Rather, he was there from the inside: this one from the body, and that one from the soul."

1039.label: Shabbos 89b
1039.rest: — "Rabbi Yitzchak said: The Holy One said to Israel: If your sins be like these years (shanim), which are arranged and come from the six days of Creation until now, they shall be white as snow (Yeshayahu 1:18)."

1040.label: Sukkah 20b
1040.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon said: It happened with Tavi, Rabban Gamliel's servant, that he would sleep under the bed. Rabban Gamliel said to the elders: Have you seen Tavi my servant, who is a Torah scholar and knows that servants are exempt from the sukkah? Therefore he sleeps under the bed. And by the way, we learned that one who sleeps under a bed has not fulfilled his obligation."

1041.label: Sotah 36b
1041.rest: — "'And she caught him by his garment' (Bereishis 39:12) — at that moment the image of his father came and appeared to him in the window and said to him: Yosef, your brothers are destined to be written on the stones of the Ephod, and you among them; do you wish your name to be erased from among them, and to be called a companion of harlots?"

1042.label: Sotah 36b
1042.rest: — "'And he came into the house to do his work' (Bereishis 39:11): Rabbi Yochanan said: This teaches that both of them intended to sin… Rav and Shmuel: one said, actually to do his work; and one said, he entered to attend to his needs."

1043.label: Rashi, Bereishis 39:1
1043.rest: — "Why was this passage juxtaposed to the episode of Yehudah [and Tamar]? To tell you that just as that one was for the sake of Heaven, so this one was for the sake of Heaven: for she saw in her astrology that she was destined to raise children from him, but did not know whether from her or from her daughter."

1044.label: Zohar III 259a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Pinchas)
1044.rest: — "In this seventh month, in which are all these commandments: 'Many waters cannot extinguish the love' (Shir HaShirim 8:7) — the love of Israel for their Father in Heaven. 'Many waters' are all the nations and their officers; 'if a man would give' — this is Samael — 'all the substance of his house' in this world, in order to share in these commandments with Israel, 'they would utterly scorn him.'"

1045.label: Sukkah 49a
1045.rest: — "Rabbah bar bar Chanah said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: The shissin were created from the six days of Creation, as it says, 'The roundings of your thighs are like jewels (chala'im), the work of the hands of a craftsman' (Shir HaShirim 7:2): 'the roundings of your thighs' — these are the shissin; 'like jewels' — that they are hollowed (mechulalin) and descend to the depths; 'the work of the hands of a craftsman' — the work of the craftsmanship of the Holy One."

1046.label: Zohar I 117a (Vayera)
1046.rest: — "And in the six hundredth year of the sixth [millennium] the gates of wisdom above and the springs of wisdom below will be opened, and the world will be prepared to enter the seventh… and your sign: 'In the six hundredth year of Noach's life… all the springs of the great deep were split open' (Bereishis 7:11)."

1047.label: Zohar I, Addenda
1047.rest: — "But when those bulls are completed, then it is written, 'And you shall draw water with joy from the wellsprings of salvation' (Yeshayahu 12:3). Who are they? The six wellsprings that pour into this 'salvation'; and then the whole world is in joy, for the Shechinah goes out from among the impurity of the other nations."

1048.label: Zohar Chadash, Toldos
1048.rest: — "On Shabbos, corresponding to the Tzaddik, Yesod Olam, who is called Kol (All), and it is called Musaf Shabbos, to add to it delights from the hidden brain; and on Rosh Chodesh, corresponding to Knesses Yisrael, who is called the moon."

1049.label: Zohar II (Terumah)
1049.rest: — "'And the middle bar in the midst of the boards, running from end to end' (Shemos 26:28) — this is holy Yaakov, the complete one… 'dwelling in tents' — two, for he holds this one and holds that one."

1050.label: Zohar II 175b (Terumah)
1050.rest: — "'And the middle bar in the midst of the boards, bolting from end to end' (Shemos 26:28) — this is Yaakov… who holds this side and holds that side. What is 'a perfect man (ish tam)'? As the Targum renders, shelim — complete on both sides, toward Atika Kaddisha and toward Ze'eir Anpin, toward supernal Chesed and supernal Gevurah."

1051.label: Zohar I 182b (Vayeshev)
1051.rest: — “Yaakov’s whole image was in Yosef… and both go together as one, and this is the secret of the letter Vav.”

1052.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a (Pasach Eliyahu)
1052.rest: — "Chesed is the right arm, Gevurah the left arm, Tiferes the body, Netzach and Hod the two thighs, Yesod the completion of the body, the sign of the holy covenant; Malchus is the mouth — we call it the Oral Torah."

1053.label: Zohar I, Addenda
1053.rest: — "And come and see: Hillel the Elder, when he rejoiced at this celebration, said: If I am here, all is here; and if I am not here, who is here? He was hinting and saying: if the Shechinah, who is called 'I' (Ani), dwells here, all is here — that place called 'all' (kol), which comes to unite with her; and if I am not here, who is here — for there is no complete good, since the Shechinah does not dwell in the Holy Land."

1054.label: Sukkah 53a
1054.rest: — "They said of Hillel the Elder: when he rejoiced at the Simchas Beis HaSho'evah, he would say: If I am here, all is here; and if I am not here, who is here?" Rashi: he expounded so in public, that they not sin — in the name of the Holy One: so long as I desire this House and My Shechinah rests in it, its glory will endure and all will come here.

1055.label: Zohar I, Addenda
1055.rest: — "On the second day, corresponding to the level of Yitzchak; on the third day, corresponding to the level of Yaakov; on the fourth day, corresponding to the level of Yosef; on the fifth day, corresponding to the level of Moshe; on the sixth day, corresponding to the level of Aharon."

1056.label: Zohar Chadash, Toldos
1056.rest: — Corresponding to the seven supernal days, He created on earth seven true tzaddikim, each corresponding to his day, the fathers of the world: Avraham, Yitzchak, Yaakov, Yosef, Moshe, Aharon and David; they are called "the ancient mountains," for they depend on those seven supernal days — the six days of Bereishis and the seventh that stands before them; as it says, "And the house of David shall be like God" (Zecharyah 12:8).

1057.label: Berachos 58a
1057.rest: — "'And the netzach' — this is the downfall of Rome, as it says, 'Their lifeblood (nitzcham) spattered upon My garments' (Yeshayahu 63:3)."

1058.label: Zohar III, Pinchas (Ra'aya Meheimna)
1058.rest: — "'For the conductor, upon the eighth' (Tehillim 12:1) — that Netzach should not move from Hod, which is the eighth sefirah. The Holy Luminary said: If so, Binah is your level; why then did they explain, 'and He gave the Hod to Moshe,' as it says, 'You shall put of your majesty (hod) upon him' (Bamidbar 27:20)?"

1059.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13, 28b
1059.rest: — "And with it Moshe praised: 'Then (az) Moshe sang' (Shemos 15:1), because it is the Hod that was given to Moshe."

1060.label: Shabbos 88a
1060.rest: — "When Israel put 'we will do' before 'we will hear,' sixty myriads of ministering angels came and tied two crowns on each one of Israel… When they sinned, they were taken off… R. Yochanan said: Moshe merited them all and took them, for next to it is written, 'And Moshe would take the tent.'" Rashi: crowns from the radiance of the Shechinah; ohel in the sense of "when His lamp shone (b'hilo)," the radiance of Moshe's face.

1061.label: Tanchuma, Ki Sisa 37
1061.rest: — "From where did Moshe merit the rays of glory? Our Rabbis said: from the cave, as it says, 'And I will place you in the cleft of the rock' (Shemos 33:22) — the Holy One placed His palm upon him, and from there he merited the rays of glory. Some say: while the Holy One was teaching him Torah, from the sparks that went forth from the mouth of the Shechinah he took the rays of glory."

1062.label: Zohar III 53b (Metzora)
1062.rest: — "Moshe is higher: Moshe is the groomsman (shushvina) of the King, Aharon the groomsman of the Matronita," appointed to adorn her and tend the house.

1063.label: Sotah 5a
1063.rest: — “'And with the crushed and lowly of spirit': Rav Huna and Rav Chisda differed. One said: 'The crushed one is with Me'; the other said: 'I am with the crushed one.' It is more reasonable to follow the one who says 'I am with the crushed one,' for the Holy One, blessed be He, left all the mountains and hills and rested His Shechinah upon Mount Sinai; Mount Sinai did not rise upward.” The preferred reading describes the Shechinah descending to the humble, rather than the humble being physically raised. It supplies the specific meaning of 'I am with the crushed one' used here.

1064.label: Sotah 5a
1064.rest: — "And it is more reasonable like the one who says 'I am with the lowly,' for the Holy One left all the mountains and hills and rested His Shechinah on Mount Sinai, and did not raise Mount Sinai upward."

1065.label: Zohar I, Addenda
1065.rest: — "On the fifteenth of the month, corresponding to the level of Aharon, who holds on to Hod and ascends also to Chesed; and therefore at this time the Holy One does good even with all the nations of the world, for the chesed of Aharon is added to the chesed of Avraham."

1066.label: Chullin 139b
1066.rest: — "From where is Moshe [alluded to] in the Torah? 'Beshagam hu basar' (Bereishis 6:3)" — beshagam is numerically Moshe.

1067.label: Bava Kamma 17a
1067.rest: — "And water means only Torah, as it says, 'Ho, all who are thirsty, go to the water' (Yeshayahu 55:1)."

1068.label: Zohar III 216b (Pinchas)
1068.rest: — "And the Rabbis further established that Moshe was destined to receive the Torah in the generation of the Flood, but because they were wicked [he did not]; this is what is written, 'beshagam hu basar' (Bereishis 6:3) — 'beshagam,' this is Moshe."

1069.label: Bava Metzia 59b
1069.rest: — "Rabbi Yehoshua stood on his feet and said: 'It is not in heaven' (Devarim 30:12). What is 'it is not in heaven'? Rabbi Yirmeyah said: For the Torah was already given at Mount Sinai; we pay no heed to a heavenly voice, for You already wrote at Mount Sinai in the Torah, 'Incline after the majority' (Shemos 23:2)." Eliyahu said that the Holy One then smiled and said: "My children have prevailed over Me."

1070.label: Bava Metzia 86a
1070.rest: — "They were disputing in the Heavenly Academy: if the bright spot preceded the white hair, he is impure; if the white hair preceded the bright spot, he is pure; if it is in doubt — the Holy One says pure, and the whole Heavenly Academy says impure. They said: Who will decide? Rabbah bar Nachmani will decide, for Rabbah bar Nachmani said: I am unique in negaim, I am unique in ohalos."

1071.label: Rambam, Hilchos Tumas Tzaraas 2:9
1071.rest: — Where it is in doubt whether the bright spot or the white hair came first, it is impure.

1072.label: Sanhedrin 109a
1072.rest: — The generation of the Dispersion said: "It is not up to Him to choose the upper realms for Himself and leave us the lower ones."

1073.label: Zohar I 27a, Bereshit 24:3
1073.rest: — “With regard to the holy limbs of the body, which are from the side of good, it is said, ‘They came to Marah and could not drink water from Marah.’ In this manner the masters of the Mishnah said: ‘They embittered their lives with hard labor’—with a difficulty; ‘with mortar’—with an a-fortiori inference; ‘with bricks’—with clarification of the law; ‘with every labor in the field’—this is baraita; ‘all their labor’—this is Mishnah.” The terms of Egyptian labor are read as forms of effort in Oral Torah. Rav Tzadok uses this original wordplay to explain another mode of overcoming Amalek.

1074.label: Kiddushin 30b
1074.rest: — "What is 'they shall speak with enemies in the gate' (Tehillim 127:5)? Rabbi Chiya bar Abba said: Even a father and son, a teacher and his student, who occupy themselves with Torah in one gate become enemies of one another; and they do not move from there until they become beloved to one another, as it says, 'es vahev besufah' (Bamidbar 21:14) — do not read besufah but besofah, in its end."

1075.label: Yevamos 14b
1075.rest: — "Beis Shammai did not refrain from marrying women of Beis Hillel, nor Beis Hillel from Beis Shammai, to teach you that they practiced affection and friendship toward one another, to fulfill what is said, 'Love truth and peace' (Zechariah 8:19)."

1076.label: Yoma 9b
1076.rest: — "And in the First Temple was there no baseless hatred? But it is written, 'They are thrust to the sword with My people' (Yechezkel 21:17) — and Rabbi Elazar said: These are people who eat and drink with one another and stab one another with the swords of their tongues."

1077.label: Sanhedrin 71b (Mishnah)
1077.rest: — "The death of the wicked is a benefit to them and a benefit to the world; to the righteous, it is bad for them and bad for the world… The gathering of the wicked is bad for them and bad for the world."

1078.label: Nedarim 38a
1078.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi son of Rabbi Chanina said: The Torah was given only to Moshe and his seed, as it says, 'Write for yourself' (Shemos 34:27), 'Carve for yourself' (34:1) — just as the chips are yours, so is the writing yours; but Moshe dealt generously with it and gave it to Israel… Rather, it was only the pilpul [the dialectic] that was given to him."

1079.label: Sanhedrin 94a
1079.rest: — "'Of the increase (lemarbeh) of his dominion and of peace there shall be no end' (Yeshayahu 9:6): Bar Kappara expounded in Tzippori: Why is every mem in the middle of a word open, and this one closed? The Holy One wished to make Chizkiyahu Mashiach and Sancheriv Gog and Magog."

1080.label: Zohar I, Addenda
1080.rest: — "Come and see: the Written Torah is called tzaddik, and it is placed in 'zos,' for this covenant is placed in it, as it is written, 'the Ark of the Covenant'… therefore 'And this (vezos) is the Torah' — the vav is joined to zos."

1081.label: Yalkut Shimoni, Emor 653 (from the Pesikta)
1081.rest: — "Whoever fulfills the mitzvah of sukkah in this world, the Holy One gives him a portion in the future in the sukkah of Sedom, as it says, 'Elokim spoke in His holiness: I will exult, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Sukkos' (Tehillim 60:8)… the valley of Sukkos — this is the sukkah of Sedom, which was shaded by seven trees one above the other."

1082.label: Zohar II 52a (Beshalach)
1082.rest: — "'Holy, holy, holy, Hashem of hosts': holy above, holy in the middle, holy below — holy Chesed, holy Gevurah, holy Tiferes; and all of them are engraved in the Seventy-Two."

1083.label: Bava Metzia 87a
1083.rest: — “Until Avraham there was no old age. One wishing to speak with Avraham would speak with Yitzchak; one wishing to speak with Yitzchak would speak with Avraham. Avraham came and asked for mercy, and old age came to be, as it says, 'Avraham was old, advanced in days.'” The Gemara explains the visible distinction of old age between father and son. Rav Tzadok reads this manifestation as the outward sign of Avraham's attainment of Atika; that mystical identification is his further interpretation.

1084.label: Zohar III 104a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Emor)
1084.rest: — "This commandment is to take the lulav on that day with its species… just as the Holy One takes Israel in these days and rejoices in them, so Israel take the Holy One as their portion and rejoice in Him."

1085.label: Rosh Hashanah 11a
1085.rest: — "On Rosh Hashanah the servitude of our fathers in Egypt ceased; in Nissan they were redeemed, and in Tishrei they are destined to be redeemed" — the view of Rabbi Eliezer, who derives that the world was created in Tishrei from "Let the earth sprout grass… fruit tree" (Bereishis 1:11).

1086.label: Chullin 63b
1086.rest: — "Rabbi Abahu said: The ra'ah is the ayah; and why is it called ra'ah? Because it sees (ro'ah) exceedingly… It was taught: it stands in Bavel and sees a carcass in Eretz Yisrael."

1087.label: Pri Etz Chaim, Shaar HaShabbos 20 (Arizal; cf. Etz Chaim)
1087.rest: — On "Ayeh mekom kevodo" in the Kedushah of Mussaf: "The secret of Ayeh: the aleph is the secret of the mazal of Atika… which is the secret of Da'as, and yod-hei are Abba and Imma; this is Ayeh." So too Tikkunei Zohar (19a): "Ayeh… yod-hei are Chochmah and Binah, aleph is Keser Elyon."

1088.label: Zohar III 194a (Balak)
1088.rest: — "'And knows the knowledge of the Most High' (Bamidbar 24:16) — he knew the hour when judgment hangs over the world, and he would aim for that hour with his sorceries."

1089.label: Zohar III (Balak)
1089.rest: — Balak sent to Bilaam and said: "Two letters of Amalek are in me, lamed-kuf, the end of Amalek; and in you is the beginning (bet-lamed)." Rabbi Shimon said: the beginning of Balak was in Bilaam, the end of Amalek was in Balak, and the end of Bilaam was the beginning of Amalek.

1090.label: Taanis 7a
1090.rest: — "As the daughter of the Caesar said to Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah: Ah, glorious wisdom in an ugly vessel! He said to her: Does your father put wine in earthen vessels? She said to him: Then in what should we put it? He said to her: You, who are important, put it in vessels of gold and silver."

1091.label: Zohar II 218a (Vayakhel)
1091.rest: — "'And go to the vessels' (Rus 2:9): these are the righteous, who are called 'vessels of Hashem,' as it is written, 'Be pure, you who bear the vessels of Hashem' (Yeshayahu 52:11)… and they are the vessels of Hashem, the vessels the Holy One uses."

1092.label: Zohar III 273b (Ra'aya Meheimna, Eikev)
1092.rest: — "And he places it in the right hand… and raises it a tefach from the ground, in the secret of yud."

1093.label: Zohar III 65b (Acharei Mos)
1093.rest: — "Come and see: the yud at first is the sum of all, hidden on every side, its paths not opened, the sum of male and female; the upper crownlet (kotza) of the yud alludes to Ayin (Nothingness). Afterwards the yud brings forth that river which flows and goes out from it… 'And a river goes out from Eden' (Bereishis 2:10)."

1094.label: Pesikta DeRav Kahana 27
1094.rest: — "'And you shall take' (Vayikra 23:40): Rabbi Abba bar Kahana opened: 'Take My instruction and not silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold' (Mishlei 8:10) — take the instruction of the Torah and not silver. 'Why do you weigh out silver for what is not bread?' (Yeshayahu 55:2) — because you were not satisfied with the bread of the Torah."

1095.label: Vayikra Rabbah 30:1
1095.rest: — "Rabbi Abba bar Kahana opened: 'Take My instruction and not silver' (Mishlei 8:10) — take the instruction of Torah and not silver. 'Why do you weigh out silver for what is not bread' (Yeshayahu 55:2)?"

1096.label: Berachos 35b
1096.rest: — "Rabbi Chanina bar Pappa said: Whoever benefits from this world without a blessing is as though he robs the Holy One and the Congregation of Israel, as it says, 'He who robs his father and his mother' (Mishlei 28:24) — 'his father' is none other than the Holy One…; 'his mother' is none other than the Congregation of Israel, as it says, 'Hear, my son, the instruction of your father, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother' (Mishlei 1:8)."

1097.label: Zohar Chadash, Ki Savo
1097.rest: — In these there is judgment and love, like a father who loves his son and takes the strap of lashes in his hand: he makes a great roar and loud noises, and the lashes are included in mercy.

1098.label: Sukkah 41b
1098.rest: — "It happened that Rabban Gamliel, Rabbi Yehoshua, Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah and Rabbi Akiva were traveling on a ship, and only Rabban Gamliel had a lulav, which he had bought for a thousand zuz."

1099.label: Zohar II 128a (Terumah)
1099.rest: — "The striving for Torah — whoever wishes merits it; the striving for the Holy One, to know Him — whoever wishes merits Him, without any payment at all. But the striving for the Holy One that stands in deed — it is forbidden to take it for free and for nothing."

1100.label: Berachos 49b
1100.rest: — "Rabbi Meir holds: 'And you shall eat' — this is eating; 'and be satisfied' — this is drinking."

1101.label: Nedarim 22b
1101.rest: — “Had Israel not sinned, they would have been given only the five books of the Torah and the book of Yehoshua… as it says, ‘For in much wisdom is much anger’ (Koheles 1:18).”

1102.label: Sukkah 52b
1102.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish said: A person's inclination overpowers him every day and seeks to kill him, as it says, 'The wicked one watches the righteous and seeks to kill him' (Tehillim 37:32); and were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him, he could not overcome it, as it says, 'Hashem will not abandon him into his hand' (Tehillim 37:33)."

1103.label: Taanis 7a
1103.rest: — "Rabbi Oshaya said: Why are words of Torah likened to these three liquids — water, wine and milk…? To tell you: just as these three liquids keep only in the lowliest of vessels, so words of Torah endure only in one whose mind is humble."

1104.label: Kiddushin 66a
1104.rest: — "'And the Torah — what will become of it?' 'Behold, it is wrapped and set down in a corner; whoever wishes to learn, let him come and learn.'" Rashi: the sefer Torah lies wrapped with the mitzvos in it, and they will not be forgotten.

1105.label: Taanis 9a
1105.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi bar Yehudah says: Three good providers arose for Israel: Moshe, Aharon and Miriam; and three good gifts were given through them: the well, the cloud and the manna. The well in the merit of Miriam, the pillar of cloud in the merit of Aharon, the manna in the merit of Moshe. When Miriam died the well departed… and it returned in the merit of both."

1106.label: Mechilta, Yisro (Amalek 3), on "And Yisro rejoiced" (Shemos 18:9)
1106.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar HaModai says: Scripture speaks of the goodness of the well. They said to him: This well that the Omnipresent gave us — we taste in it the taste of old wine, new wine, milk, honey, the taste of every sweet thing in the world." (Rabbi Yehoshua there says the same of the manna, which tasted of every food.)

1107.label: Yoma 75a
1107.rest: — "Just as an infant tastes many tastes in the breast, so the manna: as long as Israel ate it, they found in it many tastes."

1108.label: Sotah 11b
1108.rest: — "'And because the midwives feared God, He made them houses' (Shemos 1:21): one says, houses of priesthood and Levites; the other says, houses of kingship. Houses of kingship — David too came from Miriam, as it is written, 'And Azuvah died, and Kalev took Efras' (I Divrei HaYamim 2:19), and it is written, 'And David was the son of an Efrasi man' (I Shmuel 17:12)." Rashi: Azuvah is Miriam.

1109.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction 17a
1109.rest: — “You brought forth ten arrangements, and we call them ten sefirot, through which to direct concealed worlds that are not revealed and worlds that are revealed. ... Malkhut is the mouth: we call it Oral Torah.” The specific formula “Malkhut is the mouth, Oral Torah” is found in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar, in Patach Eliyahu. It complements the preceding Zohar passage about the seventh day.

1110.label: Avos 3:5
1110.rest: — "R. Nechunya b. HaKanah says: Whoever accepts upon himself the yoke of Torah, the yoke of government and the yoke of worldly affairs are removed from him; whoever casts off the yoke of Torah, the yoke of government and worldly affairs are placed upon him."

1111.label: Shabbos 30b
1111.rest: — "Rabban Gamliel sat and expounded: Eretz Yisrael is destined to bring forth ready loaves and garments of fine wool, as it says, 'May there be abundance of grain in the land' (Tehillim 72:16)."

1112.label: Berachos 58a
1112.rest: — Ben Zoma "used to say: How many labors Adam HaRishon toiled until he found bread to eat! He plowed, sowed, reaped, bound sheaves, threshed, winnowed, selected, ground, sifted, kneaded and baked, and only then ate. And I rise and find all these prepared before me." Rashi (on "all nations come to my door"): he was wealthy, and everyone came to him to trade.

1113.label: Midrash Tanchuma, Noach 3
1113.rest: — “Israel did not accept the Torah until the Holy One, blessed be He, held the mountain over them like a barrel.” The Tanchuma ties this coercion to the Oral Torah.

1114.label: Berachos 35b
1114.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai says: Is it possible that a person plows at plowing time, sows at sowing time, reaps at reaping time…? What will become of the Torah? Rather, when Israel do the will of the Omnipresent, their work is done by others, as it says, 'And strangers shall stand and shepherd your flocks' (Yeshayahu 61:5)."

1115.label: Vayikra Rabbah 30
1115.rest: — "'Pleasant things are at Your right hand forever (netzach)' (Tehillim 16:11)… Who is the victor? The one who holds the palm branch in his hand. If you have fulfilled the mitzvah of the lulav, which is called 'pleasant,' you are announced as having triumphed over the nations of the world."

1116.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 21, 60a
1116.rest: — "The Shechinah is called a positive commandment from the side of the right, and a negative commandment from the side of the left; and Torah is so called from the side of the Central Pillar."

1117.label: Yerushalmi, Berachos 9:5
1117.rest: — "Serve out of love and serve out of fear. Serve out of love: if you come to hate, know that you are one who loves, and one who loves does not hate."

1118.label: Chullin 16a
1118.rest: — "From where do we know that slaughter is with something detached? As it says, 'And Avraham took the knife to slaughter' (Bereishis 22:10)… The verse comes to teach us the alacrity of Avraham."

1119.label: Berachos 5b
1119.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

1120.label: Zohar III 2a (beginning of Vayikra)
1120.rest: — "And so with Rachav, what is written? 'Give me a true sign (os emes)' (Yehoshua 2:12) — this is the letter vav, which is called the sign of truth. And if you say the other letters are not truth — they are, but this letter is called 'the sign of truth.'"

1121.label: Zohar III, 123b
1121.rest: — “Heh and Vav never rest upon a person without fear and love, which are Yud–Heh. From there are given Torah and mitzvah, the son and daughter; because Israel fulfill Torah and mitzvah they are called children of the Holy One. ‘The hidden things’ are fear and love, within the brain and heart; ‘the revealed things’ are Torah and mitzvah, outwardly in the body and head. Whether a person fears or loves the Holy One is known only between him and his Creator. But a person’s Torah study and performance of positive commandments are visible to others.” The source distinguishes concealed intention from visible action and joins both in the four letters. The maamar insists that their union must reach actual Torah and mitzvos.

1122.label: Sotah 21a
1122.rest: — "Rabbi Menachem bar Yosi expounded: 'For a mitzvah is a lamp, and Torah is light' (Mishlei 6:23) — Scripture compared the mitzvah to a lamp and the Torah to light: the mitzvah to a lamp, to tell you that just as a lamp protects only for a time, so a mitzvah protects only for a time; and the Torah to light, to tell you that just as light protects forever, so Torah protects forever."

1123.label: Sanhedrin 44a
1123.rest: — "'Yisrael has sinned' (Yehoshua 7:11) — Rabbi Abba bar Zavda said: Even though he has sinned, he is Yisrael."

1124.label: Kiddushin 39b
1124.rest: — "One who sat and did not commit a transgression is given reward as one who did a mitzvah."

1125.label: Sukkah 2a
1125.rest: — "Rava said: From here: 'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' (Vayikra 23:42) — the Torah said: All seven days, leave your permanent dwelling and dwell in a temporary dwelling."

1126.label: Moed Katan 9b
1126.rest: — "'May your house be destroyed and your lodging be settled' — this world is your lodging and that world is your house, as it is written, 'Their inner thought (kirbam) is that their houses are forever' (Tehillim 49:12) — do not read kirbam but kivram, their grave."

1127.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13, 29b
1127.rest: — "Shemini Atzeres is a festival in its own right; on it is the welling forth of the Torah, to water the tree that is planted in the garden, and its roots and branches are like the circle (chug) of the earth, for all the festivals are celebrated in it."

1128.label: Zohar III 100b (Emor)
1128.rest: — "Then Esav, Yaakov's guardian, turned back… 'So Esav returned that day on his way to Seir' (Bereishis 33:16) — when? At the time of Ne'ilah, for he departed from the holy people, and the Holy One forgave their sins and atoned for them. Once that accuser went off with that gift and departed from them, the Holy One wished to rejoice with His children. What is written? 'And Yaakov journeyed to Sukkos' (33:17)… once they sit in sukkos, they are saved from the accuser."

1129.label: Rosh Hashanah 11b
1129.rest: — "In Tishrei they are destined to be redeemed: it is derived from 'shofar,' 'shofar': it is written here, 'Blow the shofar at the new moon' (Tehillim 81:4), and it is written there, 'And it shall be on that day that a great shofar shall be blown' (Yeshayahu 27:13)."

1130.label: Zohar II 166a (Terumah)
1130.rest: — "'For a mitzvah is a lamp, and Torah is light' (Mishlei 6:23): whoever engages in the mitzvos of the Torah in this world, for each mitzvah a lamp is arranged before him to shine for him in that world; and 'Torah is light' — one who engages in Torah merits that supernal light from which the lamp is lit. For a lamp without light is nothing, and light without a lamp likewise."

1131.label: Yalkut Shimoni, Divrei HaYamim I, remez 1080
1131.rest: — "'And behold, in my poverty (be'onyi) I have prepared for the House of Hashem' (Divrei HaYamim I 22:14)… Another explanation: be'inuyi — in my affliction: he would fast and consecrate the cost of his meal to Heaven."

1132.label: Zevachim 62a
1132.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: They saw an altar built, and Michael the great prince standing and offering upon it. Rabbi Yitzchak Nafcha said: They saw the ashes of Yitzchak lying in that place."

1133.label: Zohar III 20a (Ra'aya Meheimna)
1133.rest: — "Seventy of the Great Sanhedrin with Moshe over them, and seventy of the Small Sanhedrin with Aharon over them. Therefore the masters of the Mishnah said: Moshe was the groomsman of the King, which is Tiferes, from where the Great Sanhedrin is; Aharon the groomsman of the Matronita, which is Malchus."

1134.label: Berachos 7b
1134.rest: — "'A psalm of David, when he fled from Avshalom his son' (Tehillim 3:1) — 'a lament of David' it should have said! Rabbi Shimon ben Avishalom said: A parable of a man against whom a bill of debt came out; before he paid it he was anxious, and once he paid it he rejoiced. So with David: when the Holy One said to him, 'I will raise up evil against you from your own house' (II Shmuel 12:11), he was anxious; once he saw it was Avshalom his son, he rejoiced, for a son has mercy on his father."

1135.label: Midrash Tehillim 26
1135.rest: — "The fourth said: Why is the strap hanging? Strike me with it! — this is David, as it says, 'Judge me, Hashem' (Tehillim 26:1); and so Shlomo says, 'Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge' (Mishlei 12:1)."

1136.label: Avos 4:1
1136.rest: — "Ben Zoma says: Who is wise? One who learns from every person… Who is mighty? One who conquers his inclination, as it says, 'Better is one slow to anger than a mighty man, and one who rules his spirit than one who captures a city' (Mishlei 16:32)."

1137.label: Avodah Zarah 5a
1137.rest: — "As Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani said in the name of Rabbi Yonasan: What is meant by 'The utterance of David son of Yishai, and the utterance of the man raised on high (hukam al)' (II Shmuel 23:1)? The utterance of David son of Yishai, who raised up the yoke (ullah) of teshuvah."

1138.label: Midrash Tehillim 16
1138.rest: — "So said David the King: I have no [merit] to sit with the great ones; let me wait among the small. Let Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov be in the inner chamber, and Moshe and Aharon in the hall, and I at the threshold — 'I have chosen to stand at the threshold in the house of my God' (Tehillim 84:11)."

1139.label: Tanchuma, Ki Seitzei 10
1139.rest: — "What would the house of Amalek do? They would cut off the circumcisions of Israel and throw them upward and say: This is what You chose — take what You chose."

1140.label: Kesubos 111b
1140.rest: — "'For Your dew is a dew of lights, and the earth shall cast out the dead' (Yeshayahu 26:19): whoever makes use of the light of Torah, the light of Torah revives him; and whoever does not make use of the light of Torah, the light of Torah does not revive him." (Rashi comments only on the wording of the verse.)

1141.label: Kiddushin 30b
1141.rest: — "I created the evil inclination; I created Torah as its antidote… The school of Rabbi Yishmael taught: My son, if this repulsive one accosts you, drag him to the beis midrash: if he is stone, he will melt; if he is iron, he will shatter, as it says, 'Is not My word like fire, says Hashem, and like a hammer that shatters rock?' (Yirmeyahu 23:29)." Rashi: "this repulsive one" is the evil inclination provoking you.

1142.label: Sukkah 27a
1142.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yehotzadak: It says here 'the fifteenth,' and it says 'the fifteenth' regarding the festival of matzos: just as there the first night is obligatory and from then on optional, so here the first night is obligatory and from then on optional."

1143.label: Zohar III 103b (Emor)
1143.rest: — "Rav Hamnuna Saba, when he entered the sukkah, would rejoice and stand at the door of the sukkah inside and say: Let us invite the guests, let us set the table. And he would stand and bless and say: 'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' — be seated, exalted guests, be seated; be seated, guests of faith, be seated."

1144.label: Sukkah 55b
1144.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: These seventy bulls — corresponding to whom? Corresponding to the seventy nations. The single bull — why? Corresponding to the unique nation." Rashi: to atone for them, so that rain fall throughout the world.

1145.label: Megillah 13b
1145.rest: — "'He cast pur, that is, the lot' (Esther 3:7). It was taught: When the lot fell on the month of Adar, he rejoiced greatly. He said: The lot has fallen for me on the month in which Moshe died; and he did not know that on the seventh of Adar Moshe died and on the seventh of Adar he was born."

1146.label: Zohar II 32a (Va'era)
1146.rest: — "The children of Yishmael are destined to rule over the Holy Land, when it is empty of everything, for a long time, just as their circumcision is empty, without completeness; and they will prevent the children of Israel from returning to their place, until that merit of the children of Yishmael is used up."

1147.label: Pesachim 118b
1147.rest: — "Rava expounded: What is meant by 'I love that Hashem hears my voice' (Tehillim 116:1)? The Congregation of Israel said: Master of the world, when am I beloved before You? When You hear the voice of my supplications. 'I was brought low (dalosi), and He saved me' (116:6) — the Congregation of Israel said before the Holy One: Master of the world, even though I am poor (dalah) in mitzvos, I am Yours, and it is fitting to save me."

1148.label: Sukkah 45a (Mishnah)
1148.rest: — "Each day they would circle the altar once and say: 'Please, Hashem, save now; please, Hashem, bring success now' (Tehillim 118:25)… And on that day they would circle the altar seven times."

1149.label: Sukkah 45a
1149.rest: — "Rabbi Abahu said in the name of Rabbi Elazar: Whoever takes a lulav in its binding and a myrtle in its thickness, Scripture regards him as though he built an altar and offered a sacrifice upon it, as it says, 'Bind the festival offering with thick cords (avosim), to the horns of the altar' (Tehillim 118:27)."

1150.label: Pesachim 87b–88a
1150.rest: — Why were they exiled to Bavel? "Ulla said: So that they would eat dates and occupy themselves with Torah."

1151.label: Sukkah 45a
1151.rest: — "It was taught: [The willows were] many, long and tall — eleven cubits — so that they would bend over the altar a cubit."

1152.label: Rambam, Moreh Nevuchim III:45
1152.rest: — Since many animals were slaughtered in the Sanctuary every day, its smell would have been like that of a slaughterhouse; therefore He commanded that the incense be burned twice daily, so that the place and the garments of those who served there would have a pleasant smell.

1153.label: Mishnah, Tamid 3:8
1153.rest: — Ten things were heard in Yericho from the Beis HaMikdash: the great gate opening, the magreifah, the wooden device of Ben Katin… "and from Yericho they smelled the scent of the compounding of the incense."

1154.label: Zohar III 104a (Emor)
1154.rest: — "Let a person not say, I will first eat and be satisfied and drink, and what remains I will give to the poor; rather, the first of all belongs to the guests. And if he gladdens the guests and satisfies them, the Holy One rejoices with him, and Avraham recites over him, 'Then you shall delight in Hashem' (Yeshayahu 58:14), and Yitzchak recites over him, 'No weapon formed against you shall succeed' (Yeshayahu 54:17). Rabbi Shimon said: That is what David the King said of him, for all the King's weapons and wars were entrusted into David's hands; but Yitzchak says, 'His seed shall be mighty in the land… wealth and riches are in his house' (Tehillim 112:2–3)."

1155.label: Kiddushin 30b
1155.rest: — “My children, I created the evil inclination, and I created Torah as its antidote; if you engage in Torah, you will not be given into its hand.”

1156.label: Zohar I 202a (Miketz)
1156.rest: — “There is nothing that breaks the evil inclination except Torah.”

1157.label: Rosh Hashanah 12b
1157.rest: — "'The tithe that I gave you from them as your inheritance' (Bamidbar 18:26): the verse compares it to an inheritance — just as an inheritance has no interruption, so the first tithe has no interruption."

1158.label: Berachos 57b
1158.rest: — “Shabbos is one-sixtieth of the World to Come.”

1159.label: Sefer Yetzirah 4
1159.rest: — "He made the letter tav king… and formed with it… the day of Shabbos in the year, and the mouth in the soul."

1160.label: Berachos 4b
1160.rest: — "In the West they explain it thus: 'She has fallen, and shall no more fall; rise, maiden of Israel' (Amos 5:2). Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: Even so, David returned and supported them through ruach hakodesh, as it says, 'Hashem supports all the fallen' (Tehillim 145:14)."

1161.label: Berachos 33a
1161.rest: — “Any person who has da’as, it is as if the Beis HaMikdash were built in his days.”

1162.label: Pesachim 68b
1162.rest: — "Both expounded one verse. One verse says, 'an assembly to Hashem your God' (Devarim 16:8), and one verse says, 'an assembly shall it be to you' (Bamidbar 29:35). Rabbi Eliezer holds: either all of it for Hashem or all of it for you; Rabbi Yehoshua holds: divide it — half for Hashem and half for you." Rashi (on "for you" in the next line): that one rejoices on it with food and drink.

1163.label: Zohar II 186a (Tetzaveh)
1163.rest: — "'This month shall be for you' (Shemos 12:2): it is Mine, but I have handed it to you, so it is yours openly; but the seventh is Mine, therefore it is concealed. Your month follows the order of the letters — Aviv, which is Alef-Beis-Gimmel in order; but the seventh month, which is Mine, is from the end of the letters — Tishrei. Why? You from below to above, and I from above to below."

1164.label: Zohar II 204a (Vayakhel)
1164.rest: — “Shabbos: shin–bas. The shin is the secret of the three Avos, who unite with the only daughter, and she is crowned with them.”

1165.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13, 29b
1165.rest: — "Shemini Atzeres is a festival in its own right; on it is the welling forth of the Torah, to water the tree that is planted in the garden, and its roots and branches are like the circle (chug) of the earth, for all the festivals are celebrated in it."

1166.label: Sukkah 48a
1166.rest: — "From where are these words? As our Rabbis taught: 'And you shall be only (ach) joyful' (Devarim 16:15) — to include the night of the last Yom Tov of the festival."

1167.label: Rosh Hashanah 6b
1167.rest: — "Rav Ashi said: What is 'and we ate its offspring as shelamim on the Chag'? It teaches Chag HaShavuos." Rashi: Shavuos too may be called simply "Chag."

1168.label: Sukkah 11b
1168.rest: — "'For I made the Children of Israel dwell in sukkos' (Vayikra 23:43) — they were Clouds of Glory; the words of Rabbi Eliezer. Rabbi Akiva says: They made themselves actual sukkos."

1169.label: Taanis 9a
1169.rest: — "Rabbi Yosi bar Yehudah says: Three good providers arose for Israel: Moshe, Aharon and Miriam; and three good gifts were given through them: the well, the cloud and the manna. The well in the merit of Miriam, the pillar of cloud in the merit of Aharon, the manna in the merit of Moshe. When Miriam died the well departed… and it returned in the merit of both."

1170.label: Zohar III 103a (Emor)
1170.rest: — "Three supreme gifts were given to Israel through three siblings, Moshe, Aharon and Miriam: the manna in the merit of Moshe, the Clouds of Glory in the merit of Aharon, the well in the merit of Miriam."

1171.label: Moed Katan 9a
1171.rest: — "Rabbi Parnach said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: That year Israel did not keep Yom Kippur, and they were worried and said: Perhaps the enemies of Israel are liable to destruction. A heavenly voice went forth and said to them: All of you are destined for the life of the World to Come."

1172.label: Sanhedrin 98b
1172.rest: — "Rav Yehudah said in the name of Rav: In the future the Holy One will establish for them another David, as it says, 'And they shall serve Hashem their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them' (Yirmeyahu 30:9) — it does not say 'raised up' but 'will raise up.' Rav Pappa said to Abaye: But it is written, 'And David My servant shall be their prince forever' (Yechezkel 37:25)! — Like a Caesar and a vice-Caesar."

1173.label: Rosh Hashanah 10b–11a
1173.rest: — "Rabbi Eliezer says: In Tishrei the world was created; in Tishrei the Patriarchs were born; in Tishrei the Patriarchs died; on Pesach Yitzchak was born; on Rosh Hashanah Sarah, Rachel and Chanah were remembered; on Rosh Hashanah Yosef went out of prison… In Nissan they were redeemed, and in Tishrei they are destined to be redeemed. Rabbi Yehoshua says: In Nissan the world was created…; in Nissan they were redeemed, and in Nissan they are destined to be redeemed."

1174.label: Rosh Hashanah 4b
1174.rest: — Shemini is a festival in its own right with regard to "PZR KShV": the lottery [of the Kohanim], the time-blessing, the festival's name, the offering, the song and the blessing.

1175.label: Zohar III 104b (Emor)
1175.rest: — "And this day, Yaakov is at the head of the rejoicing, and all those guests rejoice with him; therefore it is written, 'Fortunate are you, Israel; who is like you' (Devarim 33:29), and it is written, 'And He said to me: You are My servant, Israel, in whom I glory' (Yeshayahu 49:3)."

1176.label: Sukkah 55b
1176.rest: — "Rabbi Elazar said: These seventy bulls — corresponding to whom? Corresponding to the seventy nations. The single bull — why? Corresponding to the unique nation." Rashi: to atone for them, so that rain fall throughout the world.

1177.label: Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13, 29a
1177.rest: — "A parable of a king who had a judgment and a war with seventy nations, and they did not know who had won the judgment. They asked him: Who won? He said: Look at those who are marked with weapons of war in their hands, and you will know who won."

1178.label: Zohar III 73a (Acharei Mos)
1178.rest: — "We learned: three levels are bound to one another — the Holy One, the Torah and Israel — and each one is level upon level, hidden and revealed."

1179.label: Pirkei Avot 4:1: “Who is mighty? One who conquers his inclination, as it is said, ‘One slow to anger is better than the mighty’”
1179.rest: — Ben Zoma: the mighty one conquers his inclination. Rav Tzadok ties “might” (gevurah) here to "stir up Your might" (Tehillim 80:3) said of Rachel's tribes.

1180.label: Berachos 55b
1180.rest: — "It was also taught so: All the years of David he did not see a good dream, and all the years of Achitofel he did not see a bad dream."

1181.label: Midrash Tehillim 26
1181.rest: — "The fourth said: Why is the strap hanging? Strike me with it! — this is David, as it says, 'Judge me, Hashem' (Tehillim 26:1); and so Shlomo says, 'Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge' (Mishlei 12:1)."

1182.label: Berachos 55a
1182.rest: — "Rav Chisda said: A bad dream — its sadness suffices for it; a good dream — its joy suffices for it."

1183.label: Taanis 7a
1183.rest: — "Rabbi Abahu said: Greater is the day of rain than the revival of the dead, for the revival of the dead is for the righteous, whereas rain is for both the righteous and the wicked."

1184.label: R. Yisrael of Kozhnitz, Avodas Yisrael, Shemini Atzeres
1184.rest: — “In Taanis: ‘Great is the day of rain like the day the Torah was given, as it says, “My lesson (likchi) shall drop as the rain” (Devarim 32:2)… Rava said: more than the day the Torah was given.’ This alludes to the festival of Shemini Atzeres, which they called ‘the day of rain’ because on it we bless ‘Who makes the rain fall’… Therefore Chazal alluded: ‘Great is the day of rain’ — Shemini Atzeres — ‘like the day the Torah was given,’ which is Shavuos; but Rava disagreed and said its level is greater, for on it the Oral Torah drips down drop by drop, as is known.”

1185.label: Shabbos 30a
1185.rest: — "Rabbi Yochanan said: What is meant by 'Free among the dead' (Tehillim 88:6)? Once a person dies, he becomes free of the Torah and the mitzvos."

1186.label: Berachos 18b
1186.rest: — "'But the dead know nothing' (Koheles 9:5) — these are the wicked, who in their lifetime are called dead, as it says, 'And you, profane, wicked one, prince of Israel' (Yechezkel 21:30)."

1187.label: Berachos 6a
1187.rest: — "Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said to Rav Chiya bar Avin: These tefillin of the Master of the world — what is written in them? He said: 'And who is like Your people Israel, one nation in the land' (I Divrei HaYamim 17:21)."

1188.label: Sukkah 52a
1188.rest: — "Rabbi Avira — some say Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi — expounded: The evil inclination has seven names. The Holy One called it 'evil'…; Moshe called it 'uncircumcised (orel),' as it says, 'Circumcise the foreskin of your heart' (Devarim 10:16); David called it 'impure,' as it says, 'Create for me a pure heart, O God' (Tehillim 51:12) — which implies there is an impure one."

1189.label: Taanis 7b
1189.rest: — "Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi said: Rain is withheld only because of those who speak lashon hara, as it says, 'The north wind brings forth rain, and a backbiting tongue an angry countenance' (Mishlei 25:23)."

1190.label: Rashi, Bamidbar 5:10
1190.rest: — "'And a man's holy things shall be his' — one who withholds his tithes and does not give them, the tithes will be his: in the end his field will produce only a tenth of what it used to."

1191.label: Tanchuma, Re'eh 10
1191.rest: — "Rabbi Levi said: It happened that a man would separate his tithes properly. He had one field that produced a thousand measures, and he would separate from it a hundred measures for the tithe… At his death he called his son and said: My son, pay attention to this field." The son lessened the tithe, and the field lessened its yield, until it produced only a hundred measures.

1192.label: Taanis 7b
1192.rest: — "Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai said: Rain falls only if the sins of Israel have been forgiven, as it says, 'You have favored, Hashem, Your land; You have returned the captivity of Yaakov; You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people' (Tehillim 85:2–3)."

1193.label: Zohar III 103a (Ra'aya Meheimna, Emor)
1193.rest: — "'In sukkos you shall dwell seven days' (Vayikra 23:42): this commandment is to dwell in the sukkah… to show that Israel dwell in the secret of faith without any fear, for the accuser has departed from them. And whoever is in the secret of faith sits in the sukkah, as it is written, 'Every native in Israel shall dwell in sukkos' — whoever is of the secret of faith, of the seed and root of Israel, shall dwell in sukkos."

1194.label: Pesachim 106a
1194.rest: — "Our Rabbis taught: 'Remember the Shabbos day to sanctify it' (Shemos 20:8) — remember it over wine, at its entry."

1195.label: Kerisos 19b
1195.rest: — "Rav Nachman said in the name of Shmuel: One who acts unawares (misasek) with forbidden fats and forbidden relations is liable, for he derived pleasure."

1196.label: Pesachim 119b
1196.rest: — "Rav Avira expounded: What is meant by 'And the child grew and was weaned (vayigamal)' (Bereishis 21:8)? In the future the Holy One will make a feast for the righteous on the day that He bestows (yigmol) His kindness upon the seed of Yitzchak. After they eat and drink, they give Avraham Avinu the cup of blessing to bless."

1197.label: R. Yisrael of Kozhnitz, Avodas Yisrael, Shemini Atzeres
